# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.description: 把与你相关的 GitHub PR（我提的 / 待我审 / 我合并的）照进 DSH 侧边栏，复用本机 gh 登录，只读（DeepSeek Harness 插件）
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-pr-inbox

侧边栏里的 GitHub PR 收件箱：我提的 / 待我审 / 我合并的 三桶照进 DSH 侧栏， 一眼看完"该我动手的那几件"。绑定当前会话工作区的仓库，复用本机已登录的 gh，插件不存任何凭据，只读。

## 为什么需要它 "有没有该我动的 PR" 是个**每隔十几分钟就会重新出现**的问题。现在的做法通常是： 切到浏览器 → 打开 GitHub → 在 Notifications 和几个仓库的 Pull requests 页之间来回看 → 还得自己记住哪些仓库跟自己有关。GH 的通知（网页/邮件/桌面）又是全站级别的噪音： 推送、issue、CI 失败混在一起，真正"等我 review"的那两三条淹没在里面。 这个插件把这件事挪回你**正在用的地方**： - **绑定工作区**：不用选仓库——会话在哪个仓库，面板就是哪个仓库的 PR（`upstream` 优先、其次 `origin`，再退到第一个 remote；fork 布局会绑到主仓而不是你的 fork）。 - **三桶就是三个动作语义**：`我提的`（我该跟进）、`待我审`（等我的动作，计数会变色）、 `我合并的`（我刚做的事落地没有）。想扫的时候一屏扫完。 - **点开就是全文**：正文、评论与评审摘要、改动文件清单都在面板里渲染，读 PR 描述与 讨论不用跳浏览器（看 diff / 行内 review 评论仍要 GitHub，见「已知限制」）。 - **零新凭据**：只用你**已经登录**的 `gh`。不申请 token、不填 PAT、不落盘。 与相邻方案的区别：GitHub 通知是**全站推送**（且不止 PR）；编辑器里的 GitHub 插件通常 绑在"当前文件/当前 diff"。这里是"**当前工作区 + 与我相关**"这一刀，代价是必须先装 `gh` 并登录（见下）。 ## 安装 前置：DSH 已装、本机 `gh` 已登录（`gh auth login`）。面板页签挂在 [better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) 上，所以它也要装。 **dsh 0.2.1 线需要 better-sidebar ≥ 0.28.0**：0.26.x 的 `inject` 仍要求 0.2.1 已移除的 `webRuntime`，页签会永久 pending、界面上没有任何入口。 > **当前状态：已发布到公开仓库 `omdsh-dev/dsh-pr-inbox`**（2026-10-17）。用下面的 > git 源安装；`lib/` 已随仓库提交，不需要构建授权。 **① 装页签宿主**（两种方式都要） ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar ``` **② 装本插件** ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add "github:omdsh-dev/dsh-pr-inbox" # 钉版本：用 ...#v0.1.1 ``` 本地开发/自测也可以走 tarball（需要 clone 仓库）： ```bash pnpm install && pnpm pack # 产出 dsh-pr-inbox-0.1.1.tgz dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-pr-inbox-0.1.1.tgz ``` 装完刷新页面（或按 DSH 提示重启 web）即可在**右侧栏**看到 `PR` 页签： 展开右栏 → 从页签列表里选 `PR`。 > `lib/` 构建产物随仓库提交，所以 git 源安装**不需要**任何构建授权 > （不会让你放行 `allowBuilds`，也不会在你的机器上跑构建脚本）。 ## 用起来是什么样 | | | |---|---| | **顶部** | 搜索框（标题 / 编号 / 作者 / 标签，只在已加载的行里过滤）+ `简洁/详细` 切换（选择会记住）+ 刷新 | | **简洁档** | 单行 28px：行首头像 · `#编号` · 标题 · 时间；适合快速扫 | | **详细档** | 两行 50px：第一行与简洁档**同一个位置**，第二行补作者、合并时间、标签、评论数 | | **分区块** | 三个桶各自成区，滚动时当前区的名字与计数贴在上沿；点击区头折叠。空桶只留一行计数（不显示占位文案）；只加载了一页时计数显示 `已加载 / 总数` | | **点开一行** | 面板内打开完整 PR：正文（markdown 渲染，图片走宿主代理）、评论与评审摘要、改动文件清单（状态色标 + 增删行数）；`返回列表` 会回到原来的滚动位置与行焦点，当前项有强调条；详情里按 Esc 也能返回 | | **状态行** | 底部常显绑定的仓库、当前 gh 账号与数据的读取时间（详情页也在） |

> 截图只截插件面板本身（不含宿主聊天区）；详情预览用一篇纯文字正文的 PR，避免把正文里的大图当成插件界面。 ## 能力面 | 面 | 说明 | |---|---| | 侧边栏页签 | `PR` 页签，挂在 better-sidebar 的右栏；跟随 DSH 语言（中/英）与深浅主题 | | 三桶列表 | `我提的`（`author:@me`，开着的）、`待我审`（`review-requested:@me`）、`我合并的`（`is:merged author:@me`，最近 20 条，按合并时间倒序展示） | | 行内操作 | 点行开详情；行内 `↗` 在 GitHub 打开（悬停/键盘聚焦才现形）；点击穿透不会误开外链 | | PR 详情 | 正文、评论与评审摘要（APPROVED / CHANGES_REQUESTED 等）、改动文件清单、分支与增删行、合并/更新时间；正文与单条评论有上限并**如实标注截断** | | 图片 | 正文与评论里的图片都会渲染：GitHub 编辑器插入的 `` HTML 形态会被改写成 markdown 图片，仓库内**相对路径**图片经插件自有路由代理取字节（受限网络下 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 不可达；同时也覆盖私有仓库） | | 头像 | 作者头像；CDN 不可达时回退成首字母圆底——**不会出现破图图标** | | 语言 | 界面文案随 DSH 语言（zh / en）；插件在 Plugins 页的标题与描述也有中英两份 | ## 环境与前置 - **本机 `gh` 必须已登录**：面板的数据全部来自 `gh`（列表走 `gh api search/issues`，详情走 `gh api`）。缺 `gh` 或未登录时，面板给的是可操作提示（装 gh / `gh auth login`）， 而不是空白列表。 - **只支持 `github.com`**：其它 host（自建 GitLab / Gitea 等）会在列表里留一句说明， 详情返回 `unsupported-host`。 - **需要 better-sidebar**：页签宿主。没装时 host 半照常工作，但界面上没有入口 （这是有意设计：不静默失败，也不假装能用）。 ## 已知限制 - **只读**：没有任何写操作——不评论、不 approve、不 merge，也不接管聊天里的 GitHub 链接。 - **`我合并的` 是最近 20 条**，不是时间窗；取数按 GitHub 搜索的 updated 取一页，展示时再按 合并时间倒序。**搜索只在已加载的行里做**，不会去 GitHub 全量搜。 - **详情不含 diff、行内 review 评论与 CI/checks**：review 只到 review 摘要；要读某条行内意见 或看改动本身，仍要打开 GitHub。 - **`gh` 的速率与超时**会如实反映在面板上（未登录 / 限流 / 超时各有各的提示与错误码）。 - **正文图片**只走"仓库内相对路径 + 公开/私有仓库的 `refs/pull//head`"；正文里的 外链图片直接由浏览器加载（受限网络下可能显示不出来）。 - 面板读的是**当前工作区**：会话还没确定工作目录时，面板会提示先产生一次工具调用 或打开文件，让它绑定到某个仓库。 ## 兼容性 | dsh 版本 | 状态 | |---|---| | `0.2.1-rc.1` + better-sidebar `0.28.0` | ✅ 已验证（2026-10-17）：13 个门全绿（静态 9 + git 源 / mounted 浅色+深色 / negative-control / standalone） | | `0.2.0-rc.2` + better-sidebar `0.26.x` | ✅ 已验证（2026-10-16）：真实实例里装、跑、点开详情，含 git 源安装与负控 | | 其它版本 | ⚠️ 未验证。升级 dsh 后若**右栏没有 `PR` 页签**或**面板一直空白**，多半是宿主服务名/槽名或 client 契约变了；0.2.1 线先确认 better-sidebar ≥ `0.28.0` | ## 插件管理 装/卸/启停用官方 CLI：`dsh plugin --profile web add|remove <包>`；已装插件在**侧边栏 Plugins 页**里查看与配置——每个插件自己的配置页挂在那个包页上（Settings 里的「插件」 只是只读清单，改不了配置）。 ## 开发与验证 ```bash pnpm install && pnpm build # 改源码后必须重建并提交 lib/（CI 会校验无漂移） node scripts/gates/run.mjs # 静态门：包契约 / 发布卫生 / 决策记录 / 文档链接 / 产物新鲜度 / 单测 node scripts/gates/run.mjs --list # 还有哪些实例门（真装真跑、负控、git 源安装冒烟） ``` 工程备忘录（机制、实测环境事实、验证证据、决策记录索引）在 [docs/engineering-notes.md](docs/engineering-notes.md)。 ## 许可 MIT

plugins.description: Read-only Agent Team console for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: live roster, shared task board, and collaboration activity.
plugins.readme_text:
# Agent Team Console

Read-only Agent Teams dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI (`dsh-agent-team-console`): a
project-scoped, card-grid view of every team, with a top-down pixel-art agent flow graph and rounds /
token / working-time statistics in one first-class main panel.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Repository: <https://github.com/kkomia/dsh-agent-team-console>

> **Unofficial community plugin.** This repository is not part of the DeepSeek official packages, is
> not published or endorsed by DeepSeek, and is not a replacement for the official experimental
> Agent Teams bundle. It is a read-only viewer: it never creates, changes, or completes a team
> member or a task.

## Why this plugin

The official experimental Agent Teams Web UI (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-client-ui-agent-team`)
adds a compact roster and task-board action to the conversation header. That is convenient for a
quick check while you are inside the Lead conversation, but it is not a page of its own.

Agent Team Console keeps the same read-only contract and adds a sidebar entry plus a full main
panel for people who keep a team running for a long stretch:

- A project filter and a compact status strip covering in-progress tasks, running members, token
  usage, blocked tasks, and pending tasks.
- A responsive grid of workspace cards, with at most one team expanded at a time to show the full
  detail.
- A top-down pixel-art agent flow graph: Lead at the top, teammates in balanced rows below,
  downward hand-off links and curved message arcs between them.
- A one-line task summary with in-progress rows on demand, so the page stays visual instead of a wall
  of text.

It is a plain DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web plugin: no build step for users, no npm dependencies, and no
external services.

## Features

- **Sidebar entry and main panel.** A sidebar item labelled "Team console" (the Chinese UI shows
  "团队看板") opens a dedicated page in the main area.
- **Project filter.** When more than one project (workspace) has live teams, a select appears in the
  header. It defaults to "All projects" and narrows the status strip and the team list to one project;
  the choice is client-side and is not persisted.
- **In-progress-first status strip.** A single compact row of five chips: in-progress tasks, running
  members (running / total), token usage for the current selection, blocked tasks (pending tasks that
  are not ready), and pending tasks. Zero values stay visible but muted.
- **Workspace card grid.** Teams are ordered active first, then by most recent activity, and laid out
  as a responsive grid of block cards. A collapsed card shows a status dot, the workspace/project name
  (falling back to "No project", "未分组" in the Chinese UI), an in-progress badge when non-zero, the
  Lead name, a working-vs-idle donut with team rounds and token totals, and a muted work-vs-idle
  caption. At most one team expands at a time: its card spans the full grid row and shows the full
  header, the flow graph, and the task summary. The default expanded card is the first active team; an
  explicit collapse sticks across polls.
- **Top-down flow graph.** The graph is an SVG data-flow diagram: the Lead/root sits at the top centre,
  and teammates sit in balanced rows below — a single row for up to 5 teammates, otherwise two
  balanced rows with the larger row first (up to 8 members, then a "+N" overflow node in the last row).
  Lead-to-teammate hand-off edges are curved hand-off links that flow downward with a subtle animated
  dash flow, and teammate-to-teammate message edges are curved arcs whose thickness scales with
  message weight and whose opacity scales with recency; same-row arcs bend upward so they clear the
  names. A structural hand-off graph is derived when a payload has no edge data.
- **Pixel-art agents.** Every member is drawn as a deterministic pixel-art character made of SVG
  rectangles from a 10x12 template (no external images): the Lead gets a distinct brand-colored outfit
  and marker, and the theme palette drives outfit accents. The working-ratio ring and token-scaled node
  radius are still there, with a tiny "N rounds · X tok" line under each node. Status motion: running
  bobs and shows a working spark, provisioning spins a dashed ring and blinks softly, idle is muted and
  static, failed keeps a static error ring.
- **Member details on hover or focus.** Hovering or focusing a node opens a compact detail card with
  the model, rounds, steps, token breakdown (uncached input, cache read, cache write, output, total),
  working and idle time, and the member's message in/out summary. Clicking the node opens the member's
  session when workspace navigation is available.
- **Compact task summary.** Each expanded team card shows one line with in-progress, pending, and
  blocked counts and a small expand toggle. Expanding shows only the in-progress tasks as one-line rows
  (subject, owner); pending and completed tasks stay counts only. Blocked follows the readiness rule:
  only a pending task with `ready === false` is blocked, and in-progress tasks are never shown as
  blocked.
- **Activity stays in the API.** The snapshot still carries the bounded activity list for API
  consumers, but the panel no longer renders it.
- **Interactive graph data.** When the host can see it, the snapshot also carries the member graph:
  structural Lead edges plus aggregated message edges from bounded member-session (live deliveries) and
  Lead-session (legacy records) scans. The panel remains read-only either way.
- **Multiple teams and projects.** One workspace card per live team in the grid, filtered by project
  when a project is selected.
- **Honest states.** A loading skeleton on first load, an error card with retry, a "showing the last
  successful snapshot" hint after a failed poll, an unsupported-service notice, and an empty state.
- **Bilingual.** All visible copy goes through the DSH client locale service, with Chinese and
  English dictionaries kept in sync; the panel follows the host language.
- **Theme-native.** Colors, borders, and pixel-art/graph art come only from `--dsw-*` theme tokens, so
  the panel follows dark and light themes. Graph nodes and cards are keyboard accessible and every
  animation (including the hand-off dash flow) is disabled under reduced motion.
- **Polling.** The panel refreshes a same-origin JSON snapshot every 2 seconds while it is mounted and
  the tab is visible, pauses while the tab is hidden, and offers a manual refresh button.
- **Optional navigation.** When the host exposes `uiWorkspace.openSession`, clicking a graph node
  opens that member's session. When it does not, the panel stays a read-only page.

## Requirements and compatibility

- **DSH Web UI** in the desktop app or a Web profile. The plugin was developed and tested against DSH
  `0.2.1-rc.2`; `package.json` declares `engines.dsh` as `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`, which also excludes
  0.3.0 prereleases.
- **The official experimental Agent Teams bundle must be mounted in the same profile.** This plugin
  visualizes teams that already exist; it does not provide the Agent Teams service itself. Without
  that service the panel shows a clear "not mounted" notice instead of failing.
- **Optional session projections.** Rounds, token usage, and working / idle times come from the stock
  DSH `sessionStats` and `tokenUsage` projections. They are optional: without them the panel still
  renders the graph and shows dashes for statistics.
- **A Web-capable profile.** The install examples below use the `desktop` profile; replace `desktop`
  with your own Web profile name (`web`, and so on) if it differs.
- **No separate Node.js installation is needed to use the plugin.** Node.js 22.19 or newer is only
  needed to run the tests in this repository.

## Install

The examples below use `dsh plugin --profile desktop add <spec>`. Replace `desktop` with your profile
name if you use a different Web profile.

### From the app Plugins page

1. Open **Plugins** in the DSH desktop app.
2. Choose **Add plugin**.
3. Paste `github:kkomia/dsh-agent-team-console` (or `dsh-agent-team-console` once the package is
   published

plugins.description: 一级菜单旁添加可供插件接入的“功能”菜单栏，可以快捷添加插件功能，也可以自定义插件功能置入
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-functions

给 **DeepSeek Harness** 客户端顶端加一个可扩展的 **「功能」** 标签：
插件注册进来的一键功能都在这儿，用户不用再记着「去哪儿点 / 输入什么口令」。

    [▢]  应用   编辑   功能 3 ▾
                      +----------------------------------------+
                      | 功能                                   |
                      | 插件在这里挂上自己的一键功能           |
                      | 加载功能        让会话去找非官方插件   |
                      | 读取当前会话    让当前窗口的会话读一次 |
                      | 换会话      >   真交接或演练，选一条   |
                      | 插件市场        逛社区插件、一键装     |
                      | 重启 DSH        重启 DSH，让设置生效   |
                      +----------------------------------------+

（示意图来自作者本机安装的一组插件；只装本包时，面板里只有内置的「加载功能」。）

**不 patch DSH 本体，不 require React，不引任何 Harness 客户端包** ——
它就是一个普通插件：一行 Loader 条目 + 宿主半边 + 一个自带样式的客户端 bundle。

## 装

DSH → 插件 → 添加插件，填这个包的路径（tarball 或解包目录都行），然后**重启 DSH**
（服务端不热更新；客户端那半边刷新页面就有）。

手动装也行：profile 的 `package.json` 里加一条依赖 + `dsh.profile.bundles` 一行，
再在 `node_modules` 里放一个指向它的 Junction/软链。

装好后插件页会用它包里的展示元数据（`locale/zh.json`、`locale/en.json` 里的
`meta.title` / `meta.description`）显示标题与描述，并显示包内的 `icon.svg`。
`package.json` 里对应的是顶层 `icon` 字段、`exports` 里的 `./locale/*.json`，
以及 `files` 里的 `locale/*.json` 与 `icon.svg`（0.3.1 起）。

## 五行加一条功能（宿主半边，推荐）

    // 你自己的插件 index.js
    export const inject = ['functions'];

    export function apply(ctx) {
      ctx.functions.register({
        id: 'my.tool',
        title: '干点什么',
        description: '一句话说明\n它调用的插件名',   // 第二行惯例：写它依赖的插件
        group: '我的',
        order: 10,
        confirm: { title: '干点什么', message: '现在跑？' },
        async run() { return { message: '干完了' }; },
      });
    }

`run()` 返回的 `message` 会弹在界面上；返回 `{ warnAfterMs, warnMessage }` 的话，
到点还活着就再弹一条（给「重启这种会把自己关掉的功能」兜底）。

## 字段表

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | **必填**，唯一。 |
| `title` | string | **必填**，菜单显示名。 |
| `description` | string | 说明。可以带换行：**第一行讲做什么，第二行写它调用的插件**（面板渲染两行，右对齐）。 |
| `group` | string | 分组，默认「通用」。只参与排序，标签默认不画。 |
| `order` | number | 组内排序，小在前，默认 100。 |
| `pinned` | boolean | **置顶**：永远排最上面（不受分组与 order 影响）。 |
| `parent` | string | 挂到某个父项的子菜单里（二级菜单）。写了它就不出现在顶层。 |
| `submenu` | boolean | 标记这一条是**二级菜单的父项**（容器）：自己没有动作，`run` 可以不写。 |
| `icon` | string | 预留（2026-10 之后面板不再显示单字图标，写了不报错）。 |
| `confirm` | object | 一级确认窗：`{ title, message, detail, confirmText, cancelText }`。 |
| `confirms` | array | 多级确认（静态）。只有第 0 级用得到。 |
| `prepare(stage, context)` | function | **动态**确认：第 N 级的文案在第 N-1 级点掉之后才算（「有没有任务在跑」这种话隔一次就会过期）。返回 `null` = 没有更多确认。 |
| `run(job)` | function | 执行。`job = { id, ctx, log, session, confirm, alert, toast, get, post }`。**不写 run 就必须写 `shell` 或 `submenu: true`。** |
| `shell` | object | 只想跑命令：`{ command, args, cwd }`，结果整理成一句话显示。 |
| `hidden` | boolean | 不进菜单（仍可用 API 调）。 |

二级菜单长这样（照 Windows 右键菜单的逻辑：悬停 120ms 展开、离开 180ms 收起，点父项也能展开）：

    ctx.functions.register({ id: 'family', title: '换会话', submenu: true, group: '会话' });
    ctx.functions.register({ id: 'family.go', title: '真交接', parent: 'family', run() {...} });

## config.functions：不写代码，在 YAML 里加功能（有限制）

本插件还认**自己这一行 Loader config** 里的 `config.functions`，不写代码也能加功能：

    - id: my-quick-actions
      name: dsh-functions
      config:
        functions:
          - id: open-folder
            title: 打开插件目录
            group: 工具
            confirm: { title: '打开插件目录', message: '用资源管理器打开？' }
            shell: { command: 'explorer.exe', args: ['D:/some/plugin'] }

字段与 `ctx.functions.register` 完全一样（见上面的字段表）。

**限制（重要）**：

- 本插件**没有导出 Config**：没有 schema 校验，也没有插件页里的配置表单。
  cordis 会把这一行的 config 原样传进来，所以写错了只在宿主 console 留一行日志，
  菜单里静默少一条。
- **不要为了加功能再 insert 一行 dsh-functions**。同一个插件挂两行会二次挂载：
  `provide('functions')` 与三条同 path 路由都会抛，整个插件激活失败，功能栏直接消失。
  正确做法是在 profile 补丁里按**行 id** 覆盖已有的那一行，把 `config.functions` 写在它的 config 下。
- 只想要一条功能时，更稳的是让别的插件 `ctx.functions.register(...)` —— 有代码可测。

## 三条路由（自己写客户端时才用）

    GET  /api/dshFunctions/list                 列宿主注册的功能
    POST /api/dshFunctions/prepare              { id, stage, sessionId } -> 确认窗
    POST /api/dshFunctions/run                  { id, confirm: 'yes', sessionId }

`sessionId` 是「用户正在看哪个会话」，浏览器那半边会自动带上（读客户端服务 `uiSession`）。
需要往会话里送东西的功能用它 —— **拿不到就拒，别猜**（指令发错窗口代价太大）。

## 客户端半边

功能本质上是「打开某个界面」时（打开设置里某一节、打开某个面板）才用客户端注册：

    window.__ModuleLoader__.load({
      id: 'my-plugin',
      factory(require) {
        return {
          inject: ['functions'],
          apply(ctx) {
            ctx.functions.register({
              id: 'my.open', title: '打开某面板',
              run: async (job) => { /* job.post / job.confirm / job.toast */ },
            });
          },
        };
      },
    });

面板是纯 DOM（shadow root 隔离），升级后最坏是外观退化，不会白屏。

### 顶端标签的定位（Windows 桌面专属，私有契约）

「功能」标签不是官方 slot：它站在 **Windows 桌面应用**原生「应用 / 编辑」菜单的右边，
位置靠量桌面外壳 preload 注入的私有 DOM `[data-windows-menu]` 得到。

- 只在 Windows 桌面应用里存在（`dsh-app://app` 页面）；普通浏览器、macOS 桌面没有这个锚点。
- 当前 DSH 的 slot 目录里没有「窗口标题栏 / 原生菜单条」这种 slot，所以没有官方替代。
  外壳改了这段 DOM，顶多位置退化（最坏挪到页面左上角），面板本身照常工作，不会白屏。
- 加固写法：只有 `<html data-windows-titlebar>` 存在时才按标题栏几何
  （`--dsh-windows-titlebar-height` / `--dsh-windows-menu-start`）停位；量到锚点矩形就贴它的右边；
  其它环境保留 best-effort 位置。位置更新是事件驱动的（属性变化 / 窗口 resize / 启动期有限重试），不轮询。
- 升级 DSH 后请手动点一遍「功能」栏，确认位置与面板正常。

## 内置的「加载功能」

这个插件自己内置了一条置顶功能 **加载功能**：dsh 没有「在工作区新开会话」的能力，
所以它走「把一段指令当成**用户消息**送进当前会话」这条路 ——
让会话里的 dsh 去插件库里找非官方插件、列出数字编号给用户挑，再读 README 把它们接进「功能」栏。

这条指令装插件分两条路：

1. 当前会话有 `plugin_manager` 工具（创造模式）时：用它的 `install_bundle` 直接装本地插件目录。
   **不要**手改 profile 的 `package.json`，也不要手动建 Junction。
2. 没有 `plugin_manager` 时：才退回 `link:` 依赖 + `dsh.profile.bundles` 一行 +
   `node_modules` 里 Junction 的手动装法，装完重启 DSH。

两条路的共同要求没变：目标插件目录必须由外部指定（按编号或路径，不猜「最近动过的」）；
接进「功能」栏前先读对方 README；接口拿不到就照实说「没找到」，不编。

指令里点名了下面这一节。

## 严谨猜测插件接口形式

插件自己多半没为「功能」写接口。接它的时候，最常遇到的不是「接不上」，而是**对方没写文档**。
纪律一句话：

> **推断可以，但必须留下证据链；证据不够就照实说「没找到」，不要编。**

**找接口的优先级**（从上往下，找到就停）：

1. 作者写的 README / README.zh.md / TESTING.md —— 最权威
2. 类型定义与注释（`*.d.ts`、JSDoc）
3. **注册现场源码**：`slots.inject` / `slots.register` / `ctx.provide` / `ctx.layout.selectPanel` /
   `commands` / `shortcuts` / `settings.section` / `connection.fetch.register`
4. **运行时事实**：`ctx.registry` 里有没有它的 fiber、`ctx.get('服务名')` 拿不拿得到、
   `ctx.slots.entries('槽位')` 里有没有它注册的条目
5. 它导出的东西（`exports.*`）—— 导出即承诺
6. 界面结构（DOM / 截图）—— **最后手段**，只能写成「只能点界面」

**三条禁令**：不许按名字猜、不许按别的插件套、不许按截图猜。

**每条推断写全四样**：接口形式 / 证据（文件:行）/ 反证检查（有没有更官方的路）/ 拿不到时怎么办。

**验证方式**：先写只读探针（列服务、列 slot 账本、列 DOM），别改代码试；改完留下可复现的自检；
推错了别删，把错的痕迹写下来 —— 错的痕迹比正确的结论值钱。

## 自检

自检只需要真 cordis，不需要别的插件，也不需要 DSH 在跑。

    # Windows 桌面版（推荐）：用 DSH 自带的 Electron Node 跑，cordis 会从应用包里回退解析
    $env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
    & "<DSH 安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe" test/selftest.mjs

    # 或者在干净克隆里先装一份 cordis，再用普通 node
    npm i -D @deepseek-ai/cordis
    node test/selftest.mjs

`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 不能省：少了它，`DeepSeek Harness.exe` 会按**应用模式**启动第二个
应用实例，而不是跑脚本。（cmd.exe 里的等价写法是 `set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`，再用 `&`
把后面的命令连上。）

它用真 cordis 起一个 Context，把插件挂上去，验：注册表 / 确认窗归一化 / 分级确认 /
三条路由 / 冻结顺序（历史上「注册完菜单是空的」就是这个）/ 二级菜单与置顶字段 /
内置「加载功能」的行为。当前项数以脚本输出为准。

## 升级兼容性

这个插件用了几处 DSH 的「非正式契约」，升级 DSH 前先看这一节：

1. **agents 的运行时成员**：`followup` / `status` / `inbox.nextTurn` / `inbox.nextStep` 是
   agent 运行时的成员，出现在 README 里但不在 Service 契约的类型投影里（投影只保证
   `list()` / `get()` / `{ id }`）。「加载功能」往会话里送指令靠它们，需要判断「有没有任务在跑」
   的功能也常用它们；官方改名或改语义时这些会一起失效，而且只在运行时暴露。
2. **升级后先跑自检**：装配层出问题时 `test/selftest.mjs` 比界面先报。
3. **三条 /api 路由**：`/api/dshFunctions/list|prepare|run` 依赖 connection 的 exact Fetch
   路由注册面。路由格式或鉴权分层变了，这里第一个坏（面板会显示「宿主功能清单拉不到」，
   不会白屏）。
4. **客户端模块格式**：`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 是现行客户端模块契约。
   格式变了客户端半边加载不进来，顶端就没有标签（宿主半边仍然在跑）。
5. **顶端锚点**：`[data-windows-menu]` 是 Windows 桌面壳的私有 DOM，升级后位置可能退化，
   见「客户端半边」一节。

升级后建议顺序：跑自检 -> 重启 DSH -> 打开「功能」栏点一条内置功能 -> 再动别的。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Batch approvals with a risk gate and an auditable decision ledger for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-approval-ledger

Batch approvals with a risk gate and an auditable decision ledger for **DeepSeek Harness**.

> **Status: Sprint 0 scaffold.** No usable approval feature yet. The first release will be `0.1.0` (observe-only).

## Why

DSH asks for privileged operations one at a time. Because write/command tools are scheduled exclusively, the first approval blocks everything after it: you cannot collect future approvals without letting the agent declare them first.

This plugin adds:

- **One plan for a batch.** The agent submits `request_approvals`; you review a concise list and approve once.
- **Dependency stages.** Plan items can declare `dependsOn`; the matcher only unlocks a dependent item after its dependencies are consumed.
- **Risk gate.** Every actual call is re-classified. Critical operations are never auto-approved; high-risk ones need an explicit opt-in and a second confirmation; unknown ones stay manual.
- **Decision ledger.** Every auto/manual decision is traceable through the session log plus a small metadata-only audit store.
- **Official UI first.** The shipped approval card, question card, and plan card are not replaced.

## Safety model

- `critical` is **never** auto-approved.
- `unknown` is always manual.
- Auto-approval requires **two gates**: the plan scope matches **and** the actual call is risk-eligible.
- Grants are in-memory, session-scoped, and turn-scoped; they disappear on turn end, unload, or restart.
- Any exception, parse failure, or mismatch falls back to the official approval UI.
- The audit store never records full arguments, commands, reasons, or secrets.

## Install

Not yet. `0.1.0` will be published after the observe-only implementation and the first compatibility pass.

```sh
# planned
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-approval-ledger
```

## Development

Requirements: Node.js 22+, pnpm.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build
```

The package is a Cordis bundle: `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `approval-ledger` row; `lib/index.js` is the Host half.

## Documentation

- [Design](docs/design.md)
- [Threat model](docs/threat-model.md)
- [Audit / decision ledger](docs/audit.md)
- [Runtime notes](docs/runtime-notes.md)
- [Compatibility](docs/compatibility.md)
- [Handoff](HANDOFF.md)

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

## Disclaimer

Unofficial community plugin. Not affiliated with DeepSeek. Do not use the DeepSeek name or logo to imply endorsement.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Codex reset events, schedules, and source posts, with a composer status popover and the codex_reset agent tool.
plugins.readme_text: English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) # dsh-codex-reset-tracker DeepSeek Harness plugin for Codex reset status. It adds a composer entry with a compact status popover and registers the read-only `codex_reset` agent tool. ## Acknowledgements Reset signals and available translations are provided by [Did Codex Reset](https://didcodexreset.com/zh/). Thank you to its maintainers for collecting and organizing these public reset signals and providing the [read-only API](https://didcodexreset.com/zh/api.html) and [OpenAPI specification](https://didcodexreset.com/openapi/v1/openapi.json). This repository is a DSH integration of that upstream work; the API does not include account-specific quota information. Original reset announcements are from [Tibo Sottiaux (@thsottiaux)](https://x.com/thsottiaux). ## Screenshots | Light theme | Dark theme | |---|---| | | | ## What it shows - The composer entry opens a compact popover with today's reset status, the latest reset time, and the next scheduled time. - The day check uses the browser's local calendar day. Scheduled events do not count as completed resets. If `completedAt` and `effectiveAt` are unavailable or invalid, the summary uses `announcedAt`. - The popover includes the Tibo Sottiaux source post. It shows the Simplified Chinese translation and the English source when both differ. - New schedule announcements and completed reset events show an unread marker. The marker clears when the popover is open in a visible tab. - The client requests `/status` on mount and refreshes every 10 minutes. The agent tool can query status or paginated records. ## Install from source Clone the repository, then add it to a DSH profile: ```sh git clone https://github.com/loshanvren/dsh-codex-reset-tracker.git cd dsh-codex-reset-tracker dsh plugin --profile add . ``` The package is named `dsh-codex-reset` in the DSH loader and package manifest. ## Agent tool `codex_reset` supports: - `action: "status"` — the latest global and Banked reset signals and the next scheduled reset. - `action: "records"` — one page of records, filtered by `kind`, `page`, and `pageSize`. The tool accepts an optional `lang` for record translations. Successful responses are cached for 60 seconds by default. | Config | Default | Purpose | |---|---:|---| | `apiBaseUrl` | `https://didcodexreset.com/openapi/v1` | Public API base URL used by the agent tool | | `cacheTtlSeconds` | `60` | Tool response cache, from 5 to 3600 seconds | | `timeoutMs` | `20000` | Tool call timeout, from 1000 to 120000 milliseconds | Override these values under the plugin row's `config` in `cordis.patch.yml`. The public API documents a shared limit of 60 requests per hour per IP. ## License The MIT License applies to this repository's code only. It does not relicense Did Codex Reset's data or translations, or Tibo Sottiaux's post and profile image.

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: 给 DSH Desktop 的鲸鱼壁纸插件：一片会游动的海铺在界面背后，控制台 20 项实时可调
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-whale-pond 🐋

> 一只在深海里慢慢游的鲸鱼，把它的自留地铺在 **DSH** 的 Web 界面背后（桌面端窗口，或浏览器里打开的 `dsh web`）。
> 纯视觉背景插件：**不拦鼠标、不抢键盘、不碰任何业务代码**。

[![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond?color=2b6cb0)](https://github.com/wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond/releases/latest)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)
[![DSH Desktop](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH%20Desktop-0.2.0--rc.2-1f2937)](https://github.com/wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond)


## 它是什么

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Web 界面背后本来是一块不透明背景。这个插件在 `z-index:-1` 挂一张
`position:fixed` 的全屏 canvas，再把界面自己的背景 token 调成半透明玻璃 —— 于是海、光点、水母、
鲸鱼就从界面底下透出来了：

- 默认 **400 颗光点**在海里飘（可拉到 2100），鲸鱼游过去把它们吃掉，头上飘一行 `-1 token`
- 鼠标是一盏**提灯**，带着洋流把光点往鲸鱼嘴边赶
- 右下角有个**发射区**：鼠标进圈，圈里的光点和鲸鱼一起被甩出去（最远约 4 倍圈直径）
- 右上角齿轮 ⚙ 是**控制台**：12 个滑杆 + 7 个开关 + 1 个下拉 + 1 个词库框，改完立刻变
- 齿轮左边还有一个 **■ / ▶ 一键停用**：动画停、玻璃撤掉、界面回到原样，设置会记住
- **五种运动方式**（漂移 / 飘落 / 上浮 / 洋流 / 漩涡）+ **呼吸灯**，和鼠标吸引、发射台叠加生效
- 深浅色主题自动跟随；`prefers-reduced-motion` 时跑 120 帧后定格；页面隐藏时暂停


## 安装

前提：**页面必须是 DSH 自己的 Web 界面** —— 桌面端窗口，或者用 `dsh web` 起在浏览器里打开，两者都行
（见下面「在浏览器里用」）。插件走的是 DSH 的客户端插件机制（`window.__ModuleLoader__`），所以不能当普通
`<script>` 塞进别的网页；但它**不是 Electron 专属**，Chromium 内核的浏览器里实测正常。
仓库里已经带了生成好的 `lib/client.js`，**装的时候不需要 Node、不需要 Python、不需要构建**。

### 方式 A：一条命令从 GitHub 直装（推荐）

```bash
# 1) 先确认活动 profile —— 这个文件里 "active" 那一项就是（常见 desktop / web）
cat "$APPDATA/DSH Desktop/profile-selection"

# 2) 用桌面端自带的 CLI，把 GitHub 上的包直接装进 profile（dsh 一般不在 PATH 里）
DSH="/c/Program Files/DSH Desktop"        # 换成你自己的安装目录
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 DSH_HOME="$HOME/.dsh" "$DSH/DSH Desktop.exe" \
  --expose-internals "$DSH/resources/app/lib/desktop-cli.js" \
  plugin --profile desktop add "github:wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond"
```

`plugin add` 后面的参数是**原样转给 pnpm** 的，所以三种写法都行：

| 写法 | 例子 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GitHub 简写 | `github:wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond` | 装当前 main 的最新提交 |
| git URL | `git+https://github.com/wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond.git` | 同上，可加 `#v1.0.0` 钉版本 |
| 本地目录 | `"D:/code/dsh-whale-pond"` | 装成 `link:`，改源码刷新即生效 |

### 方式 B：先 clone 再装（想改源码用这个）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond.git "D:/code/dsh-whale-pond"
# 然后照上面第 2 步，最后一段换成：
#   plugin --profile desktop add "D:/code/dsh-whale-pond"
```

改完 `src/whale_pond.html` 或 `src/whale_panel.js` 后跑 `python build/build.py` 重新生成
`lib/client.js`（只要 Python 3 + 标准库，没有第三方依赖）。

**新增插件包必须重启一次 DSH**（客户端入口要重新扫描）。之后再改代码就只要刷新页面（Ctrl+R）。
从 GitHub 装的是**中性默认词**版本；你自己的词库存在 `localStorage`，不受影响。

### 方式 C：下载 zip（离线 / 机器上没有 git）

到 [Releases](https://github.com/wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond/releases/latest) 下载 `dsh-whale-pond-1.1.0.zip`
（约 50 KB，里面是 `package.json` + `lib/` + `cordis.patch.yml` + `README.md` + `LICENSE`），
解压出 `dsh-whale-pond/`，再把上面的命令最后一段换成那个目录：

```bash
... plugin --profile desktop add "D:/下载/dsh-whale-pond"
```

zip 里的 `lib/client.js` 就是生成好的产物（47,669 B），解压即可用，不需要构建。

卸载：把上面的 `add` 换成 `remove`。

### 在浏览器里用（不打开桌面端窗口）

插件跑在 DSH 的 Web 界面里，所以只要页面是 DSH 提供的，用浏览器打开效果完全一样。桌面端自带的 CLI 就能起
一个纯 Web 实例：

```bash
DSH="/c/Program Files/DSH Desktop"          # 换成你自己的安装目录
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 DSH_HOME="$HOME/.dsh" "$DSH/DSH Desktop.exe" \
  --expose-internals "$DSH/resources/app/lib/desktop-cli.js" \
  --profile web --port 4407 --no-open
```

它会打印一行 `http://127.0.0.1:4407/?token=…`，复制到 Chrome / Edge 里打开就有鲸鱼、光点和控制台。
**插件要装进提供这个页面的那个 profile** —— 上面安装命令里的 `--profile desktop` 换成 `--profile web` 即可。

两点要知道：

- 桌面端窗口自己那个端口（默认 `43120`）是给 Electron 渲染进程用的：浏览器直接开会被 DSH 的鉴权挡住（401），
  插件路由还带 `x-dsh-desktop-renderer` 头校验。这是宿主自己的限制，跟插件无关。
- 实测用的是 Chromium 内核（Chrome / Edge）；Firefox / Safari 没测，理论上没问题（只用到 canvas 2D、CSS 变量和 localStorage）。

## 控制台

界面右上角的小齿轮 ⚙（悬停变亮）点开就是控制台，拖动即时生效、不用刷新。
设置存在 `localStorage['whale-pond-settings-v1']`（词库单独一个键），面板底部「恢复默认（词库保留）」一键回默认。

| 分组 | 控件 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 开关 | 启用壁纸 ☑（和右上角 ■ / ▶ 等价） | 开 |
| 界面 | 面板不透明度 · 画布亮度 | 0.34 · 1.6 |
| 海 | 光点数量 · 光点速度 | 400 · 1.0 |
| 鼠标（提灯） | 洋流吸引光点 ☑ · 吸引半径 · 吸引强度 · 显示吸引范围光环 ☑ | 340px · 1.0 |
| 吃光点 | 飘字「-1 token」☑ · 飘字「吃掉「词」」☑ | 都开 |
| 词库 | 一行一个词，最多 200 个 / 每个 24 字，改一下存一下 | 内建 10 个词 |
| 右下角发射台 | 启用发射台 ☑ · 圈半径 · 距右下角 · 弹射力度 | 170px · 132px · 4.0 |
| 光点运动 | 运动方式 · 运动强度 · 呼吸灯 ☐ · 呼吸快慢 | 漂移 · 1.0 · 关 · 1.0 |
| 性能 | 内部清晰度 · 运行状态（只读） | 1.0 |

## 停用 / 恢复

要认真工作、不想再看海的时候，点右上角齿轮左边那个 **■** 就停（停用后按钮变成 **▶**、亮橙色，再点一下回来）；
也可以打开控制台，最上面「开关」组里取消「启用壁纸」。两条路等价，状态存在 localStorage，**刷新页面依然是停的**。

它是真停，不是把画布藏起来：

- `cancelAnimationFrame` 停掉动画，canvas `display:none`；
- 120ms 吃光点、12s 造带词光点两个定时器和补货入口都提前返回；
- 宿主那层玻璃**整份撤掉**（`tokens.reset()`：body 的 `background:transparent !important` 与 8 个 `--dsw-alias-bg-*` 覆盖全部移除），界面回到原本不透明的深色；
- 齿轮与面板留着当入口（齿轮降到 0.3 透明度），控制台「运行状态」会写「已停用 · 动画停、玻璃已撤」。

恢复时按 `tokens.apply()` → `run()` → 补齐光点数 的顺序来，不会出现「海回来了但界面还是实心」的中间态。
真页面实测：停用前 1.2 秒画 28,263 个弧，停用后同一窗口 **0** 个；禁缓存重载后仍 `display:none` / 0 弧，勾回来立刻恢复到 27,287 个弧。

## 实现要点（这些坑都踩过）

- **canvas 要 `z-index:-1`，但光这样是看不见的**：body 自己的不透明背景画在负 z-index 后代之上，
  样式表压不住主题规则 —— 必须 `document.body.style.setProperty("background","transparent","important")`（inline + important 实测必胜）。
- **设计 token 定义在 body 上、不在 html 上**：往 `documentElement` 写等于白写。token 覆盖成半透明后，
  界面自己就变玻璃了（透明度表在 `lib/client.js` 的 `TOKENS`）。
- **背景要烘焙**：海面渐变 + 暗角很贵，改成离屏 canvas 各烘一次（背景 1/4 分辨率、暗角只在建立或改尺寸时烘），
  每秒的离屏重绘像素量从 3.3M 降到 254K。
- **光点要批量画**：按类型分 4 桶、每桶一次 `fill()`；呼吸灯再按 3 档亮度分桶（每帧 fill 29 → 45，仍然不掉帧）。
- **「跟手」得用阻尼弹簧 + 距离比例力**：把弹簧力写成单位向量会让拉力弱约 100 倍，光点「越赶越散」。
- **发射出去的光点要免疫鼠标吸引**（`if(lamp.on && !(m.lz>0))`），否则会被鼠标自己拽回来、飞不远。
- **帧门 `if(dt < 24) return;` + `document.hidden` 暂停 + DPR ≤ 1.5 + 32fps 上限**，4K 屏也稳。
- **停用要做成「可逆的拆除」**：rAF 只留一个入口（`run()`），停时 `cancelAnimationFrame` 并把 `running` 置假；画布 `display:none` 比停止绘制更彻底（连合成都不做）；玻璃背景必须 `tokens.reset()` 逐个 `removeProperty`，只覆盖不撤会永远留着半透明。

## 改它

```
src/whale_pond.html   # 原版海洋小游戏 —— 物理与绘制的来源（build.py 按行号引用它）
src/whale_panel.js    # 控制台（面板）源码
build/build.py        # 生成器：按行号剪裁 src/whale_pond.html + 注入补丁 → lib/client.js
lib/client.js         # 生成产物（已提交，装完即用，不需要构建工具）
test/harness.html     # 离线夹具：假 __ModuleLoader__ + 手动 rAF 泵，无头浏览器 3 秒跑完
test/probes/*.js      # 真页面 CDP 探针（停用开关 / 运动方式 / 控制台 / 词库 / 发射区 / 越界值 / 全控件扫描）
```

重建（会重写 `lib/client.js`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`package.json`）：

```bash
python build/build.py
node --check lib/client.js
```

### 离线夹具（不用起 DSH）

```bash
msedge --headless=new --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --virtual-time-budget=300000 \
  --dump-dom "file:///$(pwd)/test/harness.html" | grep -o 'RESULT {.*}'
```

夹具返回一大坨 JSON：每帧 `arc` 调用数、光点数量、控制台 20 个控件的读数、
五种运动方式的平均位移（最近邻匹配）、呼吸灯的半径分布、离屏烘焙成本，
以及两个历史 bug 的回归项（面板开着时 Esc 不穿透、localStorage 越界值自动夹紧）。

### 真页面探针

先起一个测试用的 DSH 实例，再用无头 Edge 连上去：

```bash
node test/front.mjs 4406                        # 让标签页前台化（否则 rAF 一帧不发）
node test/cdp.mjs test/probes/motion.js shot.png 4406
```

`test/cdp.mjs <探针.js> <截图.png|""> <url 子串>`，截图参数传空串就只求值。

## English

A purely visual wallpaper plugin for **DSH Desktop**: a whale, drifting motes and jellyfish are
drawn on a fixed `z-index:-1` canvas behind the web UI, while the UI's own background tokens are
made translucent so the sea shows through. The mouse acts as a lamp that herds motes toward the
whale; a launch pad in the bottom-right corner blasts motes and the whale away; a gear panel
exposes 20 live controls (count, speed, motion mode, breathing light, word list, render scale, …).
No input is intercepted, nothing is fetched, there are no dependencies.

Install: `dsh plugin --profile <profile-name> add <this folder>`, then restart DSH once.

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tool-cost-hint

> 不告诉你花了多少钱，只告诉你每个工具往你的上下文里塞了多少东西。

纯被动观察插件：**不注册工具**、**不往模型上下文写任何东西**、**不 append 任何 session 事件**。
它只监听 `session/event`，在每轮结束时整理出"这一轮谁调了哪些工具、各几次、各自注入多少 token"。

**当前范围：host 面（记账）+ client 面（对话流内一行可折叠提示，`conversation.chat.turnTail`）。**
host 面归因口径与第一轮完全一致，第二轮只新增了"把已有折叠结果送到浏览器"的通道和渲染层，没有改动任何计数逻辑。

---

## ⚠️ 安装前必读（桌面版用户）

**DSH 桌面版（Electron）的 `desktop` profile 被主进程独占，`dsh plugin` 命令对它是只读的：**

```text
$ dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:.../dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application
```

这不是权限问题、也不是命令写错，而是设计如此——桌面端的 profile 由 Electron 应用自己管理。
**所以如果你的 DSH 是桌面版，安装本插件的唯一方法就是手动改配置文件**，`dsh plugin add` 永远会失败。

### 桌面版手动安装（三步）

设你的用户目录为 `%USERPROFILE%`（即 `C:\Users\<你的用户名>`），插件包放在任意位置，例如
`C:\Users\you\Downloads\dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz`。

**第 1 步：把包装进 profile。** 打开命令行，在
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\` 里执行（这一步只是解包，不会触发 Electron 限制）：

```bash
npm install "C:\Users\you\Downloads\dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz"
# 或者用 pnpm（DSH 自带）：pnpm add "C:\Users\you\Downloads\dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz"
```

装完应该出现 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-tool-cost-hint\dist\index.js`。
（如果想直接链接源码目录调试，改用 `npm install "file:C:/path/to/dsh-tool-cost-hint"`，
或在 `node_modules` 里建一个指向源码目录的 Junction。）

**第 2 步：改 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`。** 用记事本打开，改两处：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    // ……原有的依赖都保留，只追加下面这一行……
    "dsh-tool-cost-hint": "file:C:/Users/you/Downloads/dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // ……原有的 bundle 都保留，数组末尾追加下面这一项……
        "dsh-tool-cost-hint"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

两处都要改，缺一不可：
- `dependencies` 让它能被 `require` 解析到（路径写成 `file:` + 正斜杠，或 `link:` 指向源码目录）；
- **`dsh.profile.bundles` 数组末尾的 `"dsh-tool-cost-hint"` 才是真正让它被加载的开关**。
  写进 bundles 后，loader 会自动套用它自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 把 `tool-cost-hint` 这行插进组合。

改之前建议先备份 `package.json`。**注意 JSON 不允许注释**，上面代码块里的 `//` 只是说明，别抄进文件。

**第 3 步：完全退出 DSH 进程再重开**（不是关窗口；插件在启动时组合，托盘退出或任务管理器结束进程都行）。

### 验证装好了没有

重开后随便发一轮**用到工具**的消息（比如让它读个文件），回复底部操作栏上方会出现一行：

```text
🛠 read ×1 · pwsh ×2 · ≈3.4K tok
```

点它展开：逐行的 `工具名 / ×次数 / 输入 / 输出`，末行 `注入量 ≈Z tok`。**没有这一行就是没装上**，按顺序查：

1. `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json` 里两处都改了吗？（最常见的原因就是只改了 `dependencies` 忘了 `dependencies` 之外的 bundles）
2. `node_modules\dsh-tool-cost-hint\dist\index.js` 存在吗？
3. 重启时是不是只关了窗口、进程还活着？

> 非桌面版（`dsh web` / `dsh tui` 命令行启动）不受影响，可以直接
> `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:<tgz 路径>`，无需手改 JSON。

---

## 0. 怎么把插件发给别人

**最简单的办法：直接发这个固定下载链接。**

```text
https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint/releases/latest/download/dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
```

这个链接指向带着**预构建 `dist/`** 的 tarball，永远指向最新 Release，不会失效。
对方下载后一条命令装好（命令行版）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
```

桌面版看本文件开头的「⚠️ 安装前必读」——`dsh plugin` 对 desktop profile 一定会失败，必须手改 `package.json`。

当前 Release：https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint/releases/tag/v0.2.0

---

**注意：本仓库的网页地址本身不是一个可以直接安装的地址。**

```text
# ❌ 这些都不行（网页地址不是安装源）
dsh plugin add https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint
```

DSH 的安装来源只有三种（[官方文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/develop/basic/publish)）：

| 来源 | 命令形态 | 能不能用在本插件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| npm 包名 | `dsh plugin --profile web add <包名>` | **暂不可用**——还没发布到 npm registry |
| GitHub 源码 | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint` | **可用**，但拉的是源码，对方要能连 GitHub 且本机得有构建工具链 |
| Release / 本地 tarball | `dsh plugin --profile web add ./x.tgz` | **可用且最省事**，`dist/` 已经打包在里面 |

> 注意：`github:` 源拉的是**源码**而不是构建产物（`dist/` 不进 git）。
> 对方装完如果没有构建产物，插件加载会失败。想省掉这一步就用 Release 里的 tarball（路线 A）。

### 路线 A：发 tarball 文件（现在就能用，推荐）

**推荐直接发 Release 链接**，不用自己打包：

```text
https://github.com/qiyuexue-xiyu/dsh-tool-cost-hint/releases/latest/download/dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
```

也可以自己打包后发文件（`dist/` 必须先构建好，见第 8 节）：

```bash
npm run build
pnpm pack        # 或 npm pack，产出 dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
```

把 `dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz`（约 32 KB）通过微信 / 网盘 / 邮件发给对方，对方执行：

```bash
# 非桌面版
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz
```

桌面版按本文件开头的「⚠️ 安装前必读」手改 `package.json`（`dsh plugin` 对 desktop profile 永远会失败）。

安全提示：对方用非官方渠道拿到的文件时，先核对 sha256 再装（Windows）：

```bash
certutil -hashfile dsh-tool-cost-hint-0.2.0.tgz SHA256
```

`v0.2.0` 的期望值：`73190410b86206af6e4b5785dec006f2ca59a7c6ce8c97b637607285fb19cba6`

### 路线 B：发布到 npm registry（之后就能"一个包名直接装"）

发布后对方只需要：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tool-cost-hint
```

需要的东西：

1. 一个 npm 账号（https://www.npmjs.com/signup），本机 `npm login`；
2. `npm publish`（包名 `dsh-tool-cost-hint` 目前**未被占用**，已确认 registry 返回 404）；
3. 之后每次更新 `npm version patch && npm publish`。

这是唯一能做到"我发个名字，对方一条命令装好"的路线。注意 `dist/` 必须在发布前构建好——包里的 `files` 白名单要求 `dist/` 存在（见第 8 节）。

### 路线 C：进 DSH Plugin Hub 插件市场（覆盖面最大）

[DSH Plugin Hub](https://dsh-plugin.org/zh/plugins)（`dsh-plugin` 包，装完在「设置 → 插件市场」）靠爬虫自动收录，收录条件写得很明确：

- **GitHub 公开仓库** + 仓库 Topics 加 `dsh-plugin`（爬虫只认 GitHub）；
- README 含可复制的安装命令（本文件已有）；
- 导出 `apply(ctx)`（本插件已导出）。

仓库已经是 GitHub 公开仓库，剩下的就是给仓库加 `dsh-plugin` topic，然后到 https://dsh-plugin.org/zh/submit 提交。

### 三条路怎么选

- 只想给一两个朋友试：**路线 A**，一分钟搞定；
- 想让人一条命令装、且能持续更新：**路线 B**（需要 npm 账号）；
- 想被更多人搜到：**路线 C**（仓库已满足条件，去提交即可）。

> 补充：部分 DSH 版本的客户端界面上有「添加插件」输入框，可以填包名 / GitHub 仓库地址 / 本地目录路径。
> 填 GitHub 地址时拉的是源码（可能需要本机构建）；**填本地 `.tgz` 的完整路径最稳**，因为 `dist/` 已经打包好了。

---

## 1. 文件清单

```
dsh-tool-cost-hint/
├─ package.json          # dsh.bundle + dsh.client 声明 + 依赖
├─ cordis.patch.yml      # 组合插入行（同时可用作 --patch 覆盖）
├─ tsconfig.json         # 只做类型检查（noEmit），产物交给 tsdown
├─ tsdown.config.ts      # 构建 host 入口 → dist/index.js
├─ tsdown.client.config.ts # 构建 client 入口 → dist/client.js（包 __ModuleLoader__ 壳）
├─ README.md
└─ src/
   ├─ index.ts           # apply()：监听、记账、轮末折叠、emit
   ├─ events.ts          # 纯函数：事件读取/校验 + token 定价
   ├─ types.ts           # host 对外契约：ToolUsage / TurnToolUsageSummary / Config
   ├─ contract.ts        # host↔client 共享的形状：投影 key + ToolCostHintView
   ├─ wire.ts            # 投影定义：同一套折叠逻辑 + wire.view（浏览器数据通道）
   └─ client/
      ├─ index.tsx       # 折叠条组件 + slot 注册 + 惰性降级
      ├─ style.ts        # 内联 CSS 字符串（client 产物必须自包含）
      └─ types.ts        # client 侧结构类型（不依赖 Harness Client 包）
```

---

## 2. 归因口径（本插件唯一的"技术核心"）

| 字段 | 含义 | 来源 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inputTokens` | 该工具**调用侧**注入量：本轮 tool/call 事件里 tool-call 块的（工具名 + 参数 JSON）token | `estimate`（官方公式） |
| `outputTokens` | 该工具**结果侧**注入量：tool/result 追加进模型可见 surface 的那条 tool 消息的 token | `meter` 优先，`estimate` 回退 |
| `injectedTokens` | 前两者之和，**UI 上展示的就是这个数**，标签为"注入量" | 派生 |

为什么叫"注入量"而不是"花费量"：

- provider 只报整轮的 usage（uncachedInput / cacheRead / output …），**没有任何 per-tool 计费数据**；
- 命中缓存后，"注入 3000 token"和"花了 3000 token 的钱"是两件事。
- 因此本插件不引入任何价格换算、不显示金额；计价留给 `dsh-bill` 这类插件，两边口径不重叠。

为什么 `inputTokens` 只能是估算：

- `tool/call` **不是 surface 事件**（模型可见 surface 只有 system/developer/user/assistant 消息和 tool/result），
  它在 `ctx.tokenMeter.measure()` 里没有独立节点，拿不到官方数字；
- 但 tool-call 块确实会进入下一次请求，必须算进去；
- 于是用 token meter **自己的**定价公式（`estimate.js` 的 tool-call 分支）：
  `ceil(name.length/4) + ceil(arguments.length/4) + 4`，并**不计 block.id**（上游也不计，计了就对不上）。

> 结论：这不是"重算一个已有的数"，而是"补一个框架没有单独露出来的数"，且公式与框架逐字一致。
> 数据结构里用 `inputTokensSource` / `outputTokensSource` 显式标出来源，UI 上可以区分"计量"与"估算"。

---

## 3. 事件时机（为什么等 `turn/end`）

| 事件 | 到达时做什么 | 为什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `turn/start` | 建本轮累加器 | 拿到 `startedSeq` / `startedAt`，用于时长与定位 |
| `tool/call` | `calls += 1`，累加 `inputTokens`，登记待配对调用 | O(1)，参数已在事件里，不需要任何服务 |
| `tool/result` | 配对 `callId`，累加 `errors`，**只记 seq + 一个估算数字** | 不缓存结果正文：工具结果动辄几十 KB，长会话里留在插件内存里既浪费又长期驻留 |
| `turn/end` | **调一次** `ctx.tokenMeter.measure()`，用节点 tokens 覆盖估算值，折叠成摘要，emit | `measure()` 是 O(surface) 的整表快照，只能一轮一次；此时本轮所有结果都已落地，数据到了终态 |

未配对情况都显式记录，不静默吞掉：

- `unattributedCalls`：发了 tool/call 但没等到 tool/result（中断/仍在跑）→ `outputTokens` 记 0，`calls` 与 `inputTokens` 照算；
- `orphanResults`：收到 tool/result 但没有配对调用（插件中途加载、框架补写恢复结果）→ 归到合成桶 `(unattributed)`，结果 token 照算。

---

## 4. 推送接口设计（三层，第三层第二轮已落地）

三层，边界很清楚：

1. **内存态（host 内部）**：`WeakMap<Session, SessionBook>`，`SessionBook.turns: Map<turn, TurnAccumulator>`
   就是需求里的 `Map<turnId, ToolUsage[]>` 进行中形态；轮次结束后折叠成
   `SessionB

plugins.description: Session bell for DeepSeek Harness: mark a conversation, and when it finishes answering the machine plays an alarm and the page flashes a card.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-aviso-sessao

Session bell for DeepSeek Harness: mark a conversation, and **when it finishes
answering** the machine plays an alarm and the page flashes a card.

## Why the sound is not played by the tab

A hidden browser tab is frozen after a few minutes: none of its timers run, so an
alarm built in the page only fires when the person is already back, exactly when
it is useless. Here the **harness process** plays the sound (it does not freeze),
through `pw-play`, `aplay`, `afplay` or `ffplay`, and the page only shows the
visual part. If the GUI window is focused, the host stays silent: the person is
already looking at the screen.

## How it works

| Half | File | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| host | `index.js` | keeps the marked conversations on disk, listens to `api-session/status`, plays the alarm, sends a desktop notification and serves `/aviso-sessao/api/*` |
| page | `client.js` | bell in the conversation header, flashing card in the global layer, and the tab title blinking |

The two halves meet over HTTP on the local host. The page reports whether it is
focused on every poll (5 s), and that is what decides between sound and silence.

## Requirements

- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the same range DeepSeek Harness supports).
- **pnpm** on `PATH` (the harness manages profile plugins with it).
- A sound player: `pw-play` or `aplay` on Linux (PipeWire/ALSA), `afplay` on
  macOS (built in), `ffplay` on Windows (part of FFmpeg). Without one the card
  still works; only the sound is lost.

## Install

```sh
npm install -g pnpm
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-plugin-aviso-sessao
# restart the harness (stop `dsh web` and start it again)
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

If `dsh` is installed globally, step 2 is
`dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-plugin-aviso-sessao`.

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` installs it **and**
adds its line to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile manifest. The bundle layer
is read at boot, so a restart is what activates it.

### Remove

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-aviso-sessao   # then restart
```

## Use

- Ring the bell in the conversation header to mark (or unmark) that conversation.
- When a marked conversation finishes answering, the alarm plays and a card
  flashes in the GUI; the tab title blinks while the alert is pending.
- Click the card (or the bell) to dismiss the alert.

## Configuration

Config lives on the profile patch (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`); a
patch replaces the whole config of the line, so restate what you want to keep:

```yaml
- id: aviso-sessao
  config:
    statePath: '~/.dsh/aviso-sessao.json'
    som: 'sons/alarme.wav'
    repeticoes: 3
    pausaMs: 250
    notificar: true
    tocaComFoco: false
```

| Key | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `statePath` | `~/.dsh/aviso-sessao.json` | where the state lives |
| `som` | `sons/alarme.wav` from the package | which file to play |
| `repeticoes` | `3` | how many times per alert (1 to 10) |
| `pausaMs` | `250` | silence between repetitions |
| `notificar` | `true` | also send a desktop notification |
| `tocaComFoco` | `false` | `true` plays even when the window is focused |

`statePath` is what keeps the bell lit across a page reload or a harness restart:
delete the file to unmark everything.

## Test

```sh
node --test test/      # alarm decision, config limits, player ladder
```

To hear and see it with the plugin mounted: `curl -s -X POST
http://127.0.0.1:3080/aviso-sessao/api/testar`.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-brave-cdp

Drive **your own, already-running Brave** over the Chrome DevTools Protocol: the
real window, your profile, your cookies, your logins, your tabs — including the
tab you are looking at right now.

Most browser automation launches a fresh browser it owns. This one attaches to the
one you already have open, so an agent can read a login-walled page, fill a form in
a session you are signed into, or hand a task back to you mid-flight in the same
window. Nothing is scraped from a parallel profile.

Two surfaces, one implementation:

| Surface | Use it when |
|---|---|
| **DSH tools** (`brave_tabs`, `brave_goto`, …) | an agent drives the browser — schemas, rendered results, no shell quoting |
| **`brave-cdp` CLI** (shipped in this package) | a human or script drives it, or you want `jq`/`batch` pipelines |

Both call the same CDP client, so behaviour and failure messages match.

## Tools

| Tool | Does |
|---|---|
| `brave_tabs` | list / open / focus / close tabs |
| `brave_goto` | navigate a tab (or a new one) and wait for load |
| `brave_snapshot` | interactive elements with `@eN` refs (role, name, value, href, state) |
| `brave_click` | real mouse click by `@eN` ref, CSS selector, or visible text |
| `brave_fill` | set an input / textarea / contenteditable, firing `input`/`change` |
| `brave_key` | press a key, optionally with ctrl / shift / alt / meta |
| `brave_eval` | evaluate JavaScript in the page, awaiting promises |
| `brave_wait` | wait for a selector, text, url, or document load |
| `brave_screenshot` | capture a PNG and return its path |

With no `tab` argument a tool acts on the tab the user is looking at
(`document.visibilityState === 'visible'`), and every result carries the CLI's
`tab:` header so it is clear which tab ran the call. `@eN` refs come from
`brave_snapshot` and stay valid until the page navigates.

Screenshots return a **path** rather than inline pixels: the agent reads the PNG
with whatever image-reading tool it already has, so this plugin needs no vision
pipeline of its own.

## Requirements

1. **Brave started with a CDP port.** Add the flag to the launcher's flag file
   (`~/.config/brave-flags.conf` for the Arch `brave-bin` wrapper):

   ```
   --remote-debugging-port=9222
   ```

   The flag applies at startup only, so Brave must be restarted after adding it.
   The port binds to loopback, but see [Security](#security) before enabling it.

2. **Node ≥ 22** for the CLI (it uses the built-in `fetch` and `WebSocket`; no
   dependencies). Node ≥ 22 is also required by DSH itself.

3. **DSH** with the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` peer
   packages (present in any DSH install) for the tool surface.

The CLI itself is bundled at `bin/brave-cdp.mjs`; the tools resolve it from the
package, falling back to `~/.local/bin/brave-cdp`, then to `cliPath` /
`BRAVE_CDP_CLI`.

## Install

```bash
# into a DSH profile (declares dsh.bundle.patch, so the tools row mounts itself)
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:olegedly/dsh-plugin-brave-cdp"

# or from a checkout / tarball
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-plugin-brave-cdp
```

Then confirm the endpoint is reachable:

```bash
brave-cdp status     # endpoint UP + browser version + tab count => ready
```

Standalone CLI, without DSH (not on npm yet, so install it from the repository):

```bash
npm install -g "github:olegedly/dsh-plugin-brave-cdp"   # provides `brave-cdp`
brave-cdp tabs
brave-cdp snapshot -i
brave-cdp click '@e4'
brave-cdp eval 'document.title'
brave-cdp shot page.png --full
```

## CLI

```
brave-cdp status                     endpoint, browser version, tab count
brave-cdp tabs [list]                tabs, 1-based indices, * marks the target
brave-cdp tabs new <url>             open a tab
brave-cdp tabs select <n|id|text>    focus a tab and raise its window
brave-cdp tabs close <n|id|text>     close a tab
brave-cdp open <url> [--new]         navigate (or open) and wait for load
brave-cdp back | forward | reload [--hard]
brave-cdp snapshot [scope] [-i] [--compact] [--json]
brave-cdp click <@eN|css|--text T> [--exact] [--dblclick]
brave-cdp fill <@eN|css> <text> [--append]
brave-cdp type [@eN|css] <text>
brave-cdp key <Enter|Tab|Escape|ArrowDown|...> [--ctrl --shift --alt --meta]
brave-cdp eval <js> [--file <path>|-]     evaluate JS, print JSON
brave-cdp html [css] [--text] / text [css]
brave-cdp shot [file] [--full]
brave-cdp wait <ms>|@eN|--selector S|--text T|--url U|--load
brave-cdp batch "open https://x" "wait --text Done" "shot done.png"
```

Global flags: `--tab <n|id|url-substr>`, `--json`, `--timeout <ms>`, `--port <n>`.
Env: `BRAVE_CDP_PORT` (9222), `BRAVE_CDP_HOST` (127.0.0.1), `BRAVE_CDP_TIMEOUT`.

`brave-cdp help` is the source of truth.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `cliPath` | packaged `bin/brave-cdp.mjs` | CLI to invoke |
| `port` | `9222` | CDP port (must match the Brave flag) |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | Per-call timeout |
| `screenshotTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Screenshot timeout |

The bundled patch mounts the row as `brave-cdp`; a profile's own
`cordis.patch.yml` is applied afterwards, so override that id to change the port
or point at another CLI:

```yaml
- id: brave-cdp
  config:
    port: 9223
```

## Security

CDP is **full control of the browser**: page contents, cookies, and any session
you are logged into are readable, and it can act as you on any site. The port
binds to loopback only, which limits it to local processes — that is a boundary,
not a guarantee. Add the flag when you want an agent to drive the browser, and
remove it (and restart) when you do not.

## Development

```bash
npm run check    # node --check on the plugin and the CLI
npm test         # node --test test/ (no network, no browser needed)
```

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | the nine tools: schemas, argument mapping, result rendering |
| `bin/brave-cdp.mjs` | the CDP client — transport, target selection, DOM refs, input, screenshots |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | the bundle patch that mounts the tools row |
| `test/` | CLI behaviour and packaging invariants |

Because the CDP client lives in the CLI, the plugin is a thin adapter: one tested
code path serves both the tool surface and the shell, and the DSH host process
never imports a browser-automation dependency.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

# dsh-image-pin-comment · 图片图钉标注 给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的图片预览加一层**图钉 + 评论**：在图上点一下钉一颗编号图钉， 图钉下方弹出评论框写一句话；点「插入到输入框」后，**原图 + 一段带坐标的说明**一起进草稿， 回车即发。 **发出去的是原图**，图钉只存在于屏幕上 —— 模型看到干净的图，靠文字里的坐标精确定位。 ![预览](docs/preview.png) ## 它解决什么 > 「把这个按钮往左挪 8px。」—— 模型问：哪个按钮？ > 「这里文字重叠了。」—— 模型开始认真猜「这里」是哪里。 图片进入模型后只剩像素。本插件把「这里」变成模型能直接算的东西：**图像编号 + 百分比 + 原图像素 + 容差 + 建议裁切框**。 一次可以标记多张图，每张图独立编号： ```text 这两个地方怎么改？ 【图片标注】图像 1（1200×800）锚点 2 处，已在输入框中。锚点不画在图上，按下面的坐标定位：百分比 = 锚点占图片宽高的比例，px = 原图像素坐标，裁切 = 以锚点为中心的方形区域（x0,y0,x1,y1）。 1. (x: 30.0%, y: 40.0% | px 360,320 | ±13px | 裁切 321,281,399,359) 这个按钮往左挪 8px 2. (x: 70.0%, y: 65.0% | px 840,520 | ±13px | 裁切 801,481,879,559) 这里文字重叠了 【图片标注】图像 2（900×600）锚点 1 处，已在输入框中。… 1. (x: 50.0%, y: 50.0% | px 450,300 | ±10px | 裁切 420,270,480,330) 这张图的标题要加粗 ``` ## 流程（两次回车） | 步骤 | 你做什么 | 插件做什么 | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | 点开会话里的任意图片（消息里的截图、输入框草稿图、工具返回的图） | 预览底部出现工具条：`标注 · 0 处 · 清空 · 插入到输入框` | | 2 | 点「标注」 | 进入图钉模式，光标变十字 | | 3 | 在图上任意位置左键点一下 | 落一颗空心环 + 十字准星的编号图钉，下方弹出评论框并自动聚焦 | | 4 | 打字，按 **第一次回车** | 只确认**这一颗**图钉的内容；气泡收起，仍在标注模式，可以接着钉第 2、3… 颗 | | 5 | 全部写完，点「插入到输入框」 | 把**原图**（原字节、原分辨率）放进输入框；坐标说明先记在输入框上方的一枚 chip 里，**草稿保持干净**；预览自动关闭 | | 6 | 在输入框里补一句问题，按 **第二次回车** | 发送瞬间把 chip 里的清单拼进消息，一起发出去；chip 自动消失 | 要点：**第一次回车只确认图钉，第二次回车才是发出去** —— 因为图钉可以不止一个。 ### 输入框保持干净（chip） 坐标清单默认**不落进输入框**，只在输入框上方显示一枚 chip：`● 2 张图 · 3 处锚点 [查看] [清空]`。 - **查看**：弹出完整清单（就是模型会收到的内容），只读、可选中复制； - **清空**：丢弃这一轮的锚点记录（已经插进输入框的图片不动）； - **发送**：按回车或点发送按钮时，插件先把清单拼到你的问题后面，再交给宿主发送，chip 随之收起。 宿主版本拿不到 `setDraft` / `submit` 时（例如没有会话的极端情况），插件会退回老行为：把清单直接写进草稿，保证信息不丢。 再多张图也一样：接着点开第二张、钉点、插入 → 自动写成「图像 2」，锚点编号**重新从 1 开始**。 「图像 N」按这一批里被标注的顺序编号，块里同时给出尺寸和附件名，便于和输入框里的附件对上号。 其它交互： - 点已有图钉 = 重新编辑它的评论；拖动图钉 = 挪位置（坐标跟着变）； - 气泡里 `Esc` = 取消（备注为空时这颗钉一起删掉）、`Shift+Enter` = 换行、「删除」= 删掉这颗钉； - 同一张图再次打开：**之前的锚点会被预载回来**，编号延续，坐标块就地更新（不会出现第二份「图像 N」）； - 图本来就在输入框里（草稿附件）：只补坐标说明，**不会重复插一张一样的图**； - 预览右上角 `×` / `Esc` 关掉预览，整层随预览一起消失。 ## 安装 ### A. 本地开发（推荐先这样试） ```sh cd /path/to/dsh-image-pin-comment ./scripts/install-local.sh # 默认装进 desktop profile（DSH 桌面端） ./scripts/install-local.sh web # 或 web profile ``` 它做两件事：把插件目录 symlink 进 `~/.dsh/profiles//node_modules/`， 并在该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里追加一行挂载配置（写之前会备份）。 然后刷新界面（⌘R）；若工具条没出现，重启一次 DSH。 卸载：`./scripts/install-local.sh --remove`。 ### B. 直接从 GitHub 装（推荐，不需要 npm） ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:dudhdkebesii/dsh-image-pin-comment ``` 装完重启一次 DSH（profile 的 bundle 组合在启动时展开）。 要固定版本也可以直接指向 tag：`github:dudhdkebesii/dsh-image-pin-comment#v0.2.0`。 不装 CLI 也行：桌面端 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件** 里填 `github:dudhdkebesii/dsh-image-pin-comment`。 ### C. 从 Release 的 tarball 装（离线/内网） ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/dudhdkebesii/dsh-image-pin-comment/releases/latest/download/dsh-image-pin-comment.tgz ``` ### D. 从 npm 装（发布后可用） ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-image-pin-comment ``` 本仓库自带 `cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh.bundle.patch`），装成 bundle 时插件自己挂载自己。 双挂载有保护：bundle 行与本地 install.sh 同时命中时只挂一份。 ## 它怎么工作（给改代码的人） 两个半边，都在 `lib/`： - `lib/index.js`：宿主半边，故意是空的；只负责给 loader 一个 entry，让 `dsh-client-modules` 扫到 `package.json` 里的 `dsh.client` 与 `exports["./client"]`。 - `lib/client.js`：浏览器半边，手写、无构建、不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`。 几处关键实现： | 环节 | 做法 | 为什么 | | --- | --- | --- | | 挂载点 | 只认一个稳定特征：`body > div[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]` 且直接子元素里有 ``（`ImageLightbox`），节流 `MutationObserver` 扫描，出现即挂、移除即销毁 | 不注册 slot、不动 React 树，官方改内部 API 也影响不到 | | 坐标 | 图钉一律存「原图像素」；显示时按 `rect.width / naturalWidth` 缩放，百分比在生成文本时现算 | 缩放窗口、换 DPI、导出三处永远一致 | | 图钉外观 | 空心环 + 中心留空的十字准星 + 右上角编号徽标 | 被指的字符不会被钉挡住（对着截图问「这是什么字」时全靠这点） | | 发原图 | `fetch(src)` 取回原始字节，按原扩展名作为附件塞进输入框；拿不到才退回「像素副本」 | 模型看到干净原图；不重编码、不动分辨率 | | 文本投递 | 一级 `inputActions.setDraft`（通过只读的 `conversation.input.overlay` 桥接组件拿到）→ 二级合成文本 paste → 三级 `execCommand` → 四级复制到剪贴板 | 全走 DSH 自己的入口；每级都有兜底 | | 一批多图 | `draftBatch` 按图片 `src` 记账，记录每张图已写进草稿的块；再次标注同一张图时预载锚点并就地替换该块 | 「图像 N 的锚点 1..k」永远指同一张图的同一批点，不串号 | | 草稿比对 | 空白归一化 + 下标映射后再定位块（Lexical 的 `innerText` 是 `\n\n`，我们写进去的是 `\n`） | 判断「上一批是否已经发出去」，并在原始文本上精确 splice | | 会话键 | bridge 组件卸载时只标记失效、不清空，会话键记住最后一次看到的值 | composer 重渲染的瞬间不会把多图编号清掉 | ## 自测 三档，从便宜到可信： | 脚本 | 跑什么 | 结果 | | --- | --- | --- | | `npm run check` | `node --check` 两个半边 | 语法 | | `node test/smoke.mjs` | 真实 Chrome（headless + CDP）加载 `test/fixture.html`（复刻 `ImageLightbox` + composer 的离线夹具）；bridge 档位（chip + 发送拦截）**33 / 33**，兜底档位（直接写草稿）**22 / 22** | **全部通过** | | `node test/real-flow.mjs ` | 真实 dsh 实例 + 真 composer + 真 lightbox：paste 两张图 → 分别钉点 → 插入 → 回车发送（submit 用桩替换，不真发） | **14 / 14** | `test/smoke.mjs` 覆盖的断言（A/B/C/D/E 五段场景）： - **A** 未进标注模式点图不落钉；进模式后落钉、气泡聚焦；第一次回车只确认备注、**不触发任何发送**； 锚点中心保持透明（不遮字）、环上有颜色； 发出去的是**原图**（整张图 0 个红点、锚点位置像素 = 原图灰度）；附件名 `image-1-*.png`； **插入后草稿里没有坐标块，只多了一枚 chip**（`1 张图 · 2 处锚点`）；用户自己写的问题保持原样。 - **B** 第二张图 → 「图像 2（900×600）」+ chip 变 `2 张图 · 3 处锚点`，锚点编号**重新从 1 开始**。 - **C** 同一张图再打开 → 预载旧锚点；chip 的锚点数涨到 4，同一张图不会重复插附件。 - **D** 已经在输入框里的图 → 只补记录（`已在输入框中`），附件数不变，chip 变 `3 张图 · 5 处锚点`； - **E** 在输入框打一句话按回车 → 清单被拼到问题后面并调用 `submit`，chip 收起；提交内容含三张图的块、`px`、`±容差`、`裁切框`。 重新生成夹具：`node test/build-fixture.mjs`；重新拍预览图：`node test/screenshot.mjs`。 ### 真机验证：开一个隔离实例（不碰你自己的 `~/.dsh`） ```sh APP="/Applications/DSH Desktop.app/Contents/Resources/app" CLI="$APP/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" # 1) 在临时 DSH_HOME 里造一个 web profile（复制 web 模板，不联网） DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-home node "$CLI" --profile piniso --from-default-profile web --dump-config DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-home ./scripts/install-local.sh piniso # 2) 起一个隔离的 web 实例（port 0 = 系统随便给一个），记下打印出来的 token URL DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-home node "$CLI" --profile piniso --no-open --port 0 # 3) 另一个终端跑真机链路 node test/real-flow.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:/?token=" # 4) 收工 rm -rf /tmp/dsh-home ``` `test/real-e2e.mjs ` 是更轻的一档：只验证 client bundle 加载、boot 清单收录、 locale / 主题 token 可用、观察器在真实外壳里挂上预览、图钉与气泡可用。 调试：控制台里 `__dshImagePinComment.annotators[0].state` 看实时状态； `localStorage.setItem('dsh-image-pin-comment.debug', '1')` 打开详细日志。 ## 已知限制 - 坐标是**点**，不是框。要框选请配合 `dsh-image-annotate` 那类画笔插件使用。 - 只接管 DSH 自己的图片预览（lightbox）；输入框草稿缩略图点开走同一个预览，因此同样可用。 - 消息气泡里不渲染「标注 ×N」chip（第一版只做核心链路）；坐标块作为普通文本随消息发出。 - 不提供设置页；工具条文案跟随 DSH 的 `locale`（zh / en）。 - 一次标记太多张图时坐标块会变长（每张图一块，带像素与裁切框）——刻意的取舍： 宁可文字长一点，也不要模型去猜。 ## 开源方案对照（为什么是这个做法） 调研过 DSH 生态里所有图片标注类插件（2026-10 快照），与本需求的重合度： | 项目 | 能力 | 与本需求的差距 | | --- | --- | --- | | [zhishengplus/dsh-image-annotate](https://github.com/zhishengplus/dsh-image-annotate) · MIT | 预览上加画笔/箭头/框/圆圈/文字，原分辨率导出进输入框 | 没有图钉，不产出坐标文本 | | [janewas/dsh-image-annotate](https://github.com/janewas/dsh-image-annotate) · MIT | 输入框待发图片就地标注，作为第二张附件插回 | 同上，且只针对草稿图 | | [heshuren371/dsh-annotator](https://github.com/heshuren371/dsh-annotator) · MIT | 网页/图片上**画框**+描述，Agent 拿到框坐标与 DOM | 是框不是钉，且是 agent preset + host 路由的重架构 | | [Max-Null/dsh-capture](https://github.com/Max-Null/dsh-capture) | 截图 + 框选 + 红框标注进输入框 | 面向截图，不是对已上传图片打点 | | [omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation) · MIT | 文本选区批注随消息发送、逐条编号回复 | 对象是文字不是图片，但「编号清单」的思路可借鉴 | 结论：**没有「图钉 + 坐标清单」的现成实现**，但「预览叠加 + 原图像素坐标 + 合成 paste 投递」 这套骨架已被上面两个插件在真实 DSH 上验证过，所以本插件沿用它（MIT，已在 LICENSE 里标注）， 只把「画笔」换成「图钉 + 评论 + 坐标清单」。 ## License MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)（含上游 dsh-image-annotate 的版权声明）。 与 DeepSeek 官方无关，未获其许可或背书。
