plugins.readme_text: # DSH 自定义主题 包名：`dsh-custom-theme`（0.3.0 之前叫 `dsh-theme-everforest`）。 DeepSeek Harness 的**自定义主题插件**：多套主题可新建 / 切换 / 重命名 / 复制 / 删除，每套主题都能改 配色（浅色 + 深色 + 语义色）、背景图与视觉效果、首屏立绘、以及**多条轮换文案**。 A custom-theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness: several switchable themes, each with palettes (light + dark + semantic), a wallpaper with effects, hero artwork, and multi-line copy shown in order or at random. 设置页在 **设置 → 自定义主题**（`settings.section`，id `theme-studio`）。 ## 功能 | 分组 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | 主题 | 主题列表：**双色迷你预览图标**（浅色一半 + 深色一半，取该主题的底色/强调色/前景色生成）、改名字、切换「使用」、删除（至少保留一套）、新建主题、复制当前主题；**预设主题**：Everforest、德谬歌 | | Agent 预设联动 | 每套主题可绑定若干 **Agent 预设 id**；会话使用这些预设时**自动切换到该主题**（会话的 `agentPreset` 投影一变就切换） | | 视觉风格 | 模式：浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统（写回 DSH 内置偏好） | | 配色 | 强调色、背景、前景、侧栏背景（可留空自动推导）、对比度 0–100 | | 深色配色 | 「分别设置深色配色」开关；开启后单独编辑深色的一套；关闭时按浅色色相自动生成 | | 语义色 | 成功 / 错误 / 警告 / 次要 | | 背景图 | **选择本地图片**或填图片地址、**主界面可见度 0–100%**、**子界面不透明度 0–100%**、**模糊 0–40px**、**亮度 30–200%**、**文字遮罩 0–150%**、铺满 / 适应 | | 背景音乐 | 每套主题一首：**选择本地音乐**（mp3/wav/ogg/m4a/flac）或填链接、启用开关、音量、循环、**最小化时暂停**；切换主题自动切歌 | | 首屏立绘 | **选择本地图片**或填地址、显示宽度 16–200px | | 文案 | 4 个字段（首屏标题、角标、首屏输入框提示、会话输入框提示），每个字段可放**多条**：**顺序**轮换或**随机**显示，可增删/上移/下移/换一条 | 修改即时生效（本地推导 token，不等保存回包），约 160ms 防抖后写入配置目录，页脚显示保存状态。 > 0.8.0：Agent 预设联动改成**从宿主预设列表里多选**（显示预设名称 + id，勾选即保存），不再手填 id； > 新增宿主路由 `GET /dsh-theme-studio/agent-presets`。 > > 0.7.0：新增**与 Agent 预设联动**——每套主题可绑定 Agent 预设 id，会话的 `agentPreset` 投影变化时 > 自动切换到对应主题；设置页显示最近检测到的预设 id。 > > 0.6.3：修「添加一条没反应」——以前插入空行会被归一化丢掉，现在插入可编辑的占位文案； > 同时把编辑时的重复计算缓存起来（预设设计只在版本升级时重建、token 与壁纸样式按值缓存）， > 删除/连续编辑不再卡顿。 > > 0.6.2：文案列表**高亮当前显示的那一条**，预览行标出「第 n 条」，并新增「回到第一条」——之前 > 列表顺序与「当前显示」对不上，是顺序模式每次加载后游标 +1 造成的，不是排序错误。 > > 0.6.1：**文字遮罩变成可调选项**（背景图分组里的 0–150%），0 即关闭；**最小化/切后台时自动暂停 > 背景音乐**，回来继续（每套主题可单独开关）。 > > 0.6.0：提高壁纸模式下的文字可读性——壁纸层自动叠加一层**与主题同色的遮罩（scrim）**， > 主界面底色不再完全透明（最多透出 82%），浅色的次级/段落文字会自动向正文色靠拢； > 同时新增**预设版本同步**：预设更新后，已创建的主题会自动接收新设计（手动改过的字段与壁纸保持不变）。 > > 0.5.1：预设主题行去掉「套用到当前主题」按钮，只保留两个预设按钮。 > > 0.5.0：新增**德谬歌预设主题**（依据昔涟 / 第十三位泰坦设定）与**背景音乐**；本地图片/音频改为 > 上传到宿主 `assets` 目录（不再把大图内联进文档，壁纸也不再压缩）。 > > 0.4.2：**主界面可见度与子界面不透明度拆成两个开关**（默认子界面 100% 不透明，解决设置面板/卡片 > 透出背景文字重叠）；主题列表图标改为按主题配色生成的迷你双色预览；图片地址行重排为 > 「缩略图 + 输入框 + 操作按钮 + 提示」的整行布局。 > > 0.4.1：修掉文案标题显示成 `copy.headline` 这类原始 key 的问题（补了 `copy.title.*` 词典并让 > 「当前显示」改用独立 key）；背景图与立绘都支持**直接选本地图片**。 ## 德谬歌预设（依据昔涟 / 第十三位泰坦设定） 德谬歌是昔涟的完整形态：第十三位泰坦、权杖 δ-me13 的本源，「十三种光彩」，击败铁幕、闭合因果后 以孩童模样回归最初。预设把设定落成这套观感： | 部位 | 设计 | | --- | --- | | 配色 | 浅色 **粉白**（`#fff7fc` 底 / `#e58bb4` 强调 / `#4a3a57` 前景），深色 **夜幕紫**（`#161020` 底 / `#f0a8cc` 强调 / `#f4e9f3` 前景）——粉白发色、蓝眸与星空记忆的对照 | | 立绘 | 13 个光点环绕的羽翼光环（十三种光彩，内圈成对羽翼 = 权杖本源），尺寸 96px | | 文案 | 标题「德谬歌 / 第十三泰坦 / 忆海无垠，故事为舟」，角标「第十三泰坦 / 第十三种光彩」，占位「拾起一段记忆…」「三千万次轮回，皆为你执笔」 | | 壁纸 | **不内置**：添加预设时直接沿用当前主题的壁纸（保留其可见度/模糊/亮度/铺满方式）；当前主题没有壁纸时才用内置星空兜底 | | 音乐 | 默认为空并关闭，等你放入音乐文件 | 入口：主题分组底部「预设主题：＋ 德谬歌」。 ### 预设同步 从预设创建的主题会记录 `preset / presetVersion / presetBase`（上一次预设的设计快照）： - 预设设计随插件版本更新（`PRESET_VERSION` 提升）时，**已创建的主题会自动同步**； - 同步按字段比较：只有仍等于旧预设值的字段会被替换，你手动改过的颜色/立绘/文案/音乐保持原样； - 壁纸从不属于预设，始终保留； - 旧的、改名恰好为「德谬歌」的主题会被自动认领为德谬歌预设。 ## 与 Agent 预设联动 Agent 预设（Session 的 `agentPreset` 投影）决定一个会话用哪套工具/提示词。主题可以绑定预设，在 **会话使用该预设时自动切换过去**： - 设置页「Agent 预设联动」每套主题一行：点「选择预设」展开勾选列表（**多选**，勾选即保存）， 列表来自宿主 `agentPresets.list()`（名牌 + id，加载失败的预设会标注）； - 客户端占用两个无害的会话槽位（`conversation.input.dock` 与 `conversation.hero.options`）各挂一个 不渲染的观察组件，通过标准 Hook `useProjection("agentPreset")` 读取当前会话预设，一旦变化就切主题； - 没有任何主题绑定该预设时，保持用户当前主题不动； - 设置页底部显示「当前会话的 Agent 预设」，方便核对是否命中。 ## 背景音乐 - **按主题保存**：每套主题有各自的 `music.src / enabled / volume / loop / pauseWhenHidden`，切主题即切歌； - **本地文件**：点「选择本地音乐」上传到宿主 `assets` 目录（也可直接填 https 链接）； - **最小化暂停**：窗口最小化或切到后台时自动暂停，回到界面继续（每套主题可关掉这个开关）； - **浏览器自动播放限制**：首次加载不会自动响，需要你先与页面交互一次（点击/按键），之后切换主题、 重新启用都会继续播放；关闭开关即暂停。 ## 本地文件怎么工作 本地图片/音频不再内联进主题文档，而是**上传到宿主**： 1. 客户端把选中的文件 POST 到 `/dsh-theme-studio/asset`； 2. 宿主按魔数识别类型（png/jpg/webp/gif/svg、mp3/wav/ogg/m4a/flac），写入 `/theme-studio/assets/<随机名>.`，返回同源 URL； 3. 文档里只存 URL；`GET /dsh-theme-studio/asset/` 负责提供文件（带 Range 支持，音频可拖动进度）。 旧的 `data:image/...` 内联图仍然兼容（此前版本保存的壁纸不受影响）。单文件上限 40MB。 ## 修复：配色改完又变回原色 0.2.0 的设置页把 React 的 `key`（`"light.accent"`）当成了调色板字段名去读写，于是颜色被写进 `state.light["light.accent"]` 这种无效字段，保存时被宿主归一化丢弃，回包又把旧颜色刷回来。 0.3.0 的修法有两层： 1. 键名分离：调色板行按字段名 `accent / surface / ink / sidebar / contrast` 读写； 2. **token 由客户端本地推导**：每次编辑立刻 `theme.overrideTokens()` 重绘，保存回包只作回执， 不再用服务端状态覆盖本地草案 —— 从结构上杜绝"保存后被刷回去"。 ## 架构（为什么以后改主题不用重启 DSH） - **宿主半** `lib/index.js`：薄的文档存储 + 首屏提示。 - `GET/POST /dsh-theme-studio/document`：读写 `/theme-studio/theme.json`； - `webserver/index-inject`：在页面首帧前按 `boot` 提示刷底色和壁纸，UI 挂载后由 token 接管 （`html[data-ts-ready]`）。 - **浏览器半** `client/client.js`：全部主题逻辑（文档模型、token 推导、文案、壁纸、设置页）。 它把模型导出为 `__model` 供测试使用。 因此主题功能迭代只需刷新页面（客户端半由 `dsh-client-hmr` 轮询热更新）；只有传输/宿主逻辑变化 才需要重启一次 DSH。 ## 数据 ``` /theme-studio/theme.json # 默认 ~/.dsh/theme-studio/theme.json ``` ```jsonc { "version": 1, "boot": { "light": "#fdf6e3", "dark": "#2d353b", "wallpaper": { "image": "https://…", "blur": 4, "brightness": 90, "position": "cover" } }, "state": { "version": 3, "activeThemeId": "everforest", "themes": [ { "id": "everforest", "name": "Everforest", "light": { "accent": "#93b259", "surface": "#fdf6e3", "ink": "#5c6a72", "contrast": 45, "success": "#8da101", "danger": "#f85552", "warn": "#dfa000", "idle": "#829181", "sidebar": "" }, "dark": { "accent": "#a7c080", "surface": "#2d353b", "ink": "#d3c6aa", "contrast": 45, "success": "#8da101", "danger": "#f85552", "warn": "#dfa000", "idle": "#829181", "sidebar": "" }, "separateDark": true, "background": { "image": "", "strength": 0, "panelOpacity": 100, "blur": 0, "brightness": 100, "position": "cover" }, "hero": { "image": "", "size": 34 }, "music": { "src": "", "enabled": false, "volume": 45, "loop": true }, "copy": { "headline": { "mode": "sequence", "items": ["探索未至之境"] }, "preview": { "mode": "sequence", "items": [] }, "placeholderHero": { "mode": "sequence", "items": [] }, "placeholderDefault": { "mode": "sequence", "items": [] } }, "cursor": { "headline": 1, "preview": 0, "placeholderHero": 0, "placeholderDefault": 0 } } ] } } ``` v1/v2 的单主题文档会在加载时自动迁移到 `themes` 数组。 ## 文案的轮换语义 - **顺序**：每次页面加载显示当前游标那一条，然后把游标 +1 存回文档 → 下次加载显示下一条，循环； - **随机**：每次页面加载随机挑一条（游标不动）； - 设置页的「换一条」立即把该字段切到下一条/随机一条；「回到第一条」把游标重置为 0，显示列表第 1 条； - 「添加一条」插入一条可编辑的占位文案（「新文案 / New line」）——空行会被归一化丢弃，所以不能靠 插入空串来新建； - 列表里**高亮那一行**就是当前显示的那条，预览行写着「当前显示（第 n 条）」。因为游标保存在主题里， 刷新过几次后可能在第二条——不是顺序错位，点「回到第一条」即可回到开头。 ## 背景图怎么生效 应用表面全部由 `--dsw-alias-*` token 上色，所以壁纸方案是： 1. 客户端注入 `body::before` 固定层，铺图片并按设置做模糊/亮度； 2. 壁纸层上再叠一层**与主题同色的遮罩**（浅色用浅色 surface、深色用深色 surface，透明度 = 可见度基础值 × 「文字遮罩」百分比；默认 100% 时随可见度从 0.12 升到 0.52，调 0 即关闭）。 这层在内容下方、壁纸上方，用来压住过亮/过花哨的壁纸，保证文字对比度； 3. **主界面**（页面底色 `bg-base`、侧栏 `specific-sidebar-fill`）按**主界面可见度**变半透明，但 底色最多透出 82%（不会完全消失）； 4. 壁纸开启时，次级/段落文字（`label-secondary/tertiary/caption/dimmed`）会自动**向正文色靠拢**， 解决"浅白色段落看不清"； 5. **子界面**（设置面板、弹窗、卡片、输入框等 `bg-layer-1/2`、`bg-overlay`、`specific-menu/selector`） 由**子界面不透明度**控制，默认 100% 不透明； 6. 文字与描边始终不透明；主界面可见度 0 = 完全关闭透出。 首屏由宿主的 `boot` 提示提前画好底色、壁纸与同一层遮罩，避免首帧白闪。 ## 立绘与文案的落点 - **立绘**：注册 `conversation.hero.brand.mark`（首屏标题前的品牌图形），用 `` 顶替内置小鱼； - **文案**：没有文案插槽，且同一 locale 重复注册会抛 `already has locale`，因此用 CSS `content` 覆盖宿主实际渲染的节点（`[class*="_titleGroup"]`、`[class*="_previewBadge"]`、 `[data-composer-placeholder]`，用 `:has([data-phase="hero"])` 区分首屏/会话内）。宿主改结构时 规则自然失效并回退到内置文案。 ## 安装与生效 仓库不含构建步骤：`client/client.js` 是可读的加载器产物，`lib/index.js` 只依赖 Node 内建模块。 ```powershell # 方式一：从 GitHub 安装（DSH 支持 github: spec） plugin_manager install_bundle # target: github:YOGEMOW/dsh-custom-theme # 或：dsh plugin --profile add github:YOGEMOW/dsh-custom-theme # 方式二：克隆后按本地目录安装 git clone https://github.com/YOGEMOW/dsh-custom-theme.git plugin_manager install_bundle # target: <克隆目录> ``` - 0.8.0 新增宿主 `agent-presets` 只读路由：**升级需要重启一次 DSH**（之后联动配置只需刷新页面）； - 0.5.0 新增宿

plugins.description: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin: answers ask_user_question with the recommended option when nobody replies in time, so an unattended session keeps working.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-auto-answer

**Unattended DSH sessions don't stall on `ask_user_question`.**

When nobody answers a question within a configurable window, this Host plugin claims
the request with the option the asker recommended — the `(Recommended)` / `（推荐）`
label — and the agent keeps working. If you *do* answer in time, your answer passes
through untouched and the plugin never intervenes.

Host-only bundle: nothing renders in the page, no browser half, no dependencies.

> **Known UI behaviour, by design — not a bug:** with a browser page attached, the question
> card stays on screen after an automatic answer until you dismiss it (「提交」/「跳过」 or a
> page reload). The answer is already recorded and the turn has continued; see
> *“The question card stays on screen after an automatic answer”* below.

## Install

```bash
# from GitHub (no build step: the source is the artifact)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AK-blank/dsh-plugin-auto-answer

# from a local checkout while developing
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-auto-answer
```

`dsh plugin add` writes the package into the profile and selects its bundle layer, so
the row shows up in the GUI's Plugins page and in `dsh --profile web --dump-config`
(`# == dsh-plugin-auto-answer` → `id: auto-answer`).

Installing a new bundle activates it through HMR. **Replacing an installed copy of this
plugin needs a `dsh web` restart**: Host module code is cached per process, so a changed
`lib/index.js` is not reloaded by a re-apply.

## How it works

`ask_user_question` is dispatched as the `user-questions/request` waterfall. The browser
UI answers it by rendering a question card; in a headless run nothing answers it at all.

This plugin registers **in front of** that chain (`prepend`) and calls `next()` — it is a
proxy, not a veto:

| what happens | result |
|---|---|
| a human answers inside the window | their answer wins, unchanged |
| nobody answers before the deadline | the recommended option is submitted |
| the next answerer fails outright (`NO_PROVIDER` with no page, transport ended) | the window keeps running, then the recommended option is submitted |
| the tool's own timed window expired (`ASK_TIMED_OUT`) | the recommended option is submitted immediately instead of returning `pending` |
| the turn is cancelled (`ASK_ABORTED`, signal aborted) | propagated — a cancelled turn is never answered |

The listener is registered with `{ global: true, prepend: true }`. The global flag is not
optional: Agent events are scope-filtered by the context a listener was registered on, and
a plugin installed through the plugin manager is applied inside one agent's scope — without
it the plugin would only answer the session that installed it.

## Which option counts as "recommended"

- An option label ending in `(Recommended)`, `（推荐）`, `(推荐)` or `（Recommended）`,
  case-insensitively. The option does **not** have to be first.
- The label is submitted verbatim: the marker stays in the answer, because it is the value
  the asker offered.
- Multi-select questions take every marked option.
- No marked option → `fallback` decides: `first` (default), `last`, or `none` (never answer,
  leave the question to a human).
- A question without options has nothing to choose: `freeText: skip` submits an empty
  selection — the protocol's own "skipped" answer — while `block` leaves it open.
- `plan-review` intents are **ignored by default**: approving a plan is a decision with
  consequences. `planReview: approve` / `decline` opt in explicitly.
- A batch is answered only when every question in it can be answered; the answer contract
  requires one item per question, and a partial batch would hide a human decision.

## Config

All keys are optional; the row's `config` overrides the defaults.

| key | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | master switch; `false` registers no listener at all |
| `timeoutSeconds` | `120` | window before the recommended option is chosen (5 – 86400) |
| `fallback` | `first` | `first` \| `last` \| `none` when no option is marked |
| `freeText` | `skip` | `skip` \| `block` for questions without options |
| `planReview` | `ignore` | `ignore` \| `approve` \| `decline` for plan reviews |

```yaml
# in the profile's cordis.patch.yml, after every bundle layer
- id: auto-answer
  name: 'dsh-plugin-auto-answer'
  config:
    timeoutSeconds: 90
    fallback: first
```

**With the tool's own `timed` mode**, keep `timeoutSeconds` below `tool-ask-user`'s
`timeout`; otherwise the tool returns `pending` first and this plugin's answer never
applies. The default blocking tool has no such constraint.

## Observability

Host logs in `dsh web` are not visible in the terminal, so the plugin writes an optional
JSONL trace:

```bash
DSH_AUTO_ANSWER_LOG=/tmp/auto-answer.jsonl dsh web
```

```json
{"at":"2026-10-18T03:31:56.138Z","event":"armed","agentId":"session-…","timed":false,"questions":1,"timeoutMs":20000,"picks":[{"id":"color","selected":["蓝色 (Recommended)"]}]}
{"at":"2026-10-18T03:32:16.141Z","event":"answered","agentId":"session-…","reason":"window-elapsed","timeoutMs":20000,"picks":[{"id":"color","selected":["蓝色 (Recommended)"]}]}
```

Events: `armed`, `answered`, `delegated` (a human answered), `delegate_error`, `failed`.
A broken trace path never breaks the question it describes.

## Verified behaviour

Offline self-test (`node selftest.mjs`) — 39 checks over the package contract, config
normalisation, the recommendation rules, the registration options, the timer races, and
"No unhandled rejection / no leaked timer".

Real installation path: installed into a throwaway profile with `dsh plugin add`, confirmed
as a bundle layer and row in `dsh --profile … --dump-config`, and visible on the GUI's
Plugins page under 已安装 → 无人值守自动应答.

End-to-end on a live host (blocking tool as shipped):

- **unattended**: 20 s window, question left open — the trace shows `armed` →
  `answered` exactly 20.003 s later with the recommended option, and the turn finished in
  22 s with *"你最终选择了蓝色（Recommended）。"*
- **attended**: 60 s window, the human picked the non-recommended option 24 s in — the trace
  shows `armed` → `delegated (answered-by-ui)`, the turn finished with *"你最终选了香蕉。"*,
  and the card collapsed to `1/1 已回答` normally.

## The question card stays on screen after an automatic answer — this is not a bug

**Expected behaviour, by design. Please don't file an issue for it.**

`ask_user_question` is answered through a waterfall: the browser Client renders the question
card and waits for the human's own submission, while the Host waits for whoever answers. This
plugin answers on the **Host** when the window elapses, and the Host has no message that tells
a Client its question was settled elsewhere. The card therefore stays where it was:

- it remains in the transcript, and still occupies the composer;
- the session row may keep reading 「等待回答」 (waiting for an answer).

Nothing else is affected. The `ask_user_question` result already carries the picked answer,
the turn continues and finishes normally, and the recorded session data is correct — the
stale card is browser state, not session state.

Dismiss it by clicking **提交** (submit) or **跳过** (skip), or by reloading the page.
Submitting a stale card is harmless: the request was already settled, so no late answer is
injected and no error is raised (verified). Reloading also clears the session-row label.

A Host-side plugin cannot remove that card: the card belongs to the Client's own request, and
only the Client settles it. If a future plugin should close it automatically, that needs a
Client-side change.

## Out of scope

The plugin does not touch `approval/request` (tool approvals): auto-approving a command is
a different risk class, and it is deliberately out of scope.

## Development

```bash
node selftest.mjs     # offline: no Harness, no timer left behind, no browser
```

`lib/index.js` exports `normalizeConfig`, `isRecommendedLabel`, `decideQuestion`,
`planRequest`, `createRuntime` (with injectable `now` / `setTimer` / `clearTimer` / `trace`)
and `apply` — the self-test drives the same functions the Harness loads.

MIT.

## Disclaime

plugins.description: DSH 插件：向模型暴露 Komari 探针面板工具（列机器、远程执行、上传下载文件），设置页配置面板地址与账号 | DSH plugin exposing Komari monitoring-panel tools (list nodes, remote exec, file transfer) with a settings-page config card
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-plugin-komari DSH 插件（bundle 形式）：把 [Komari](https://github.com/komari-monitor/komari) 探针面板的能力暴露给模型——**列机器**（节点清单 + 实时状态）、**控制机器**（远程执行命令）与**传输文件**（本机 ↔ 目标机），并在 WebUI 设置页配置面板地址与账号。四个工具经 [dsh-plugin-toolsets](https://github.com/huanlinoto/dsh-plugin-toolsets) 注册为一个**按需加载的工具集**。 DSH plugin (bundle): exposes a Komari monitoring panel to the model — list machines with live status, run shell commands on them, and move files between this machine and them — configured from the WebUI settings page. Tools ship as one lazily-loaded toolset through dsh-plugin-toolsets. ## 工具集（按需加载） 四个工具注册为名为 `komari` 的 toolset：平常只占一行目录（名称 + 「什么时候该用」摘要 + 工具数），模型判断需要时调用全局 `get_tools({"toolset":"komari"})` 把整组工具加载进当前 agent，**下一轮**起可用。 - 依赖 `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-toolsets`（peer，需已安装，否则本插件的 `inject: ['toolsets']` 不满足、不会加载）。 - 目录行内容即 [src/tools.ts](src/tools.ts) 里的 `TOOLSET_DESCRIPTION`。 - 子 agent 不继承：子 agent 需自行调用 `get_tools`。 ## 工具 | 工具 | 作用 | |------|------| | `komari_list_nodes` | 列出面板上的机器及其实时状态（在线、CPU%、负载、内存/磁盘/Swap、网络总量、运行时长、连接数、温度、系统、备注）。参数：`group`（分组精确过滤）、`include_offline`（默认 true）。 | | `komari_exec` | 在一台或多台机器上执行 shell 命令，返回每台的输出与 exit code。参数：`command`、`nodes`（uuid / 精确名称 / 唯一名称子串）、`wait_seconds`（默认 30，最大 300）。 | | `komari_upload_file` | 把**本机**（运行 dsh 的机器）的文件传到一台或多台机器。参数：`local_path`、`remote_path`、`nodes`。走面板分片上传协议，单文件上限 8 GiB。 | | `komari_download_file` | 把某台机器上的文件取回**本机**（流式写盘）。参数：`remote_path`、`node`、`local_path`（缺省写系统临时目录下的 `komari-downloads/`）。目录不可下载。 | `komari_upload_file` 会**覆盖目标路径上已存在的文件**，同样需要先确认。 `komari_exec` 是**危险工具**：命令经面板 agent 在目标机上以其自身权限执行（多数 Linux 节点即 root，Windows 节点为 agent 服务账户，走 PowerShell）。工具描述已要求模型在执行重启/删除/改配置/批量命令前先说明计划并取得用户明确同意；面板侧也会记录 `REC, task id: ...` 审计日志。 ## 设置页配置 「设置 → 插件」中找到 `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-komari` 这一行，展开其配置卡： | 字段 | 说明 | |------|------| | 面板地址 | 如 `https://status.example.com`；粘贴 `/api` 或 `/api/v1` 后缀会被自动去掉，无协议时默认补 `https://`。 | | 用户名 / 密码 | 面板账号，**必须是管理员**（远程执行是 admin 权限）。开启 2FA 的账号无法用于本插件（登录接口需要动态 TOTP 码）。 | | 请求超时 (ms) | 单次面板 HTTP 请求超时，默认 15000。 | 改完点「保存」即时生效（工具每次调用都读取最新配置，无需重启）；点「测试连接」会用当前已保存的配置做一次登录 + 拉取节点，验证地址与账号是否可用。 凭据以明文写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中该 entry 的 `config` 下——请自行确认该文件的权限。 ## 文件传输备注 - 上传走面板的四步协议：`operation=init`（拿 `upload_id`/分片大小）→ 逐个 `operation=chunk`（原始字节，`Content-Length` 必须等于该分片期望长度）→ `operation=merge`（提交）；任一步失败会自动 `operation=cancel` 清掉半成品。 - 面板限制：单文件 ≤ 8 GiB，分片 1 MiB–128 MiB（默认 25 MiB），上传会话 15 分钟过期，最多 4 个并发上传（因此多机上传是串行执行的）。 - 下载是 `GET .../file/download?path=<绝对路径>` 的二进制流，插件边收边写盘；总时长受「传输超时」约束。 - 路径风格随目标机：Linux 用 `/tmp/...`，Windows agent 用 `C:\Windows\Temp\...`（面板会把它规范化成 `/C/Windows/Temp`）。 ## 数据可见性与安全 - 插件以面板**管理员会话**访问 `/api/admin/*`。`GET /api/admin/client/list` 的原始响应里含每台机器的 **Agent Token**，插件在进入模型之前用显式白名单投影（`pickNode`/`pickLive`），只保留状态字段；单元测试 `tests/komari.spec.ts` 钉死了这一行为。 - 会话 Cookie 只保存在宿主进程内存中；遇到 401/403 会清掉旧会话、重新登录并重试一次。 - 密码不写入日志、不回显在工具结果里。 ## 开发 ```sh pnpm install pnpm run build # tsdown: lib/index.js (host) + lib/client.js (browser half, __ModuleLoader__ 包裹) ``` 结构： | 路径 | 职责 | |------|------| | `src/index.ts` | 入口：`name` / `inject` / `Config`（全部字段 `.volatile()`）/ `apply` | | `src/komari.ts` | `KomariClient`：登录、Cookie 会话、`/api/rpc2`、`/api/admin/*`、字段白名单投影 | | `src/tools.ts` | 四个 `defineTool` 定义、`buildKomariToolset()` 与 `registerTools()`（注册到 `ctx.toolsets`） | | `src/transfer.ts` | 本地文件 IO：分片读取上传、流式写盘下载、默认落地路径 | | `src/summary.ts` | 纯函数：节点摘要、引用解析、文本渲染（无 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖，便于单测） | | `src/rpc.ts` | 宿主 RPC：`komari.probe`（设置卡「测试连接」） | | `src/client/*` | 浏览器半：`plugins.row.config` 配置卡（row key `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-komari#dsh-komari`） | | `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 配置层：insert 一行 `dsh-komari`，`config` 是首次启动的种子值 | 约束：`lib/` 预构建入库（含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-* ` peer，git 安装时无 `prepare`）；不改 DSH 源码。 ## 运行 ```sh # 本地开发（改源码后重新 pnpm run build 即可生效，无需重装） dsh plugin --profile web add "link:D:/Projects/deepseek-harness/dsh-plugin-komari" # 从远端安装 dsh plugin --profile web add "github:huanlinoto/dsh-plugin-komari" ``` 装好后**重启 `dsh web` 进程**，浏览器硬刷新（`Ctrl+Shift+R`），再到「设置 → 插件」填上面四个字段。 ## 检查 ```sh pnpm run typecheck # tsc --noEmit pnpm test # 40 个单测（mock fetch；含 token 不泄漏回归、分片协议回归、toolset 契约） pnpm vitest run tests/e2e.komari.spec.ts # 真实面板 e2e（未设置环境变量时自跳过） ``` 真实面板 e2e 需要： ```powershell $env:KOMARI_E2E_ENDPOINT='https://status.example.com' $env:KOMARI_E2E_USERNAME='admin' $env:KOMARI_E2E_PASSWORD='...' ``` 它覆盖四条链路：登录 + 列机器、读实时状态、在**一台在线机器**上执行 `echo dsh-komari-e2e`、以及**文件往返**（上传一个小文本文件到在线机器的临时目录 → stat 校验 → 下载回来比对内容 → 删除远端文件）。只跑无害命令与临时文件。 ## 已知限制 - 面板账号开启 2FA 时无法使用：登录与 `admin:exec` 都需要动态 TOTP 码。需要这种场景时应改用面板 API Key 认证（当前未实现）。 - 只覆盖「看机器 + 控制机器 + 传文件」：节点增删改、Ping 任务管理等面板管理写入接口未暴露。 - 强依赖 `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-toolsets`：未安装时本插件因 `inject` 不满足而整体不加载（工具不可见）。

plugins.description: Patch for the DSH desktop release build: liang-themed level names for dsh-thinking-slider 0.3.3 (and why Liang-Saint-Slider silently fails there)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-thinking-slider-liang

DSH composer 里那根思考档位滑杆，档位名换成「小难梁 / 梁子 / 梁圣 / 梁祖」。

**一条命令安装，不需要打补丁、不需要额外脚本。**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:FkuNvidia/dsh-thinking-slider-liang
```

从系统托盘完全退出 DSH 再打开。点输入框左下角的模型名，滑杆里的档位就是中文名了。

## 效果

- 触发器：`deepseek-flash · 梁圣`
- 卡片大字档位、滑轨刻度：小难梁 / 梁子 / 梁圣 / 梁祖
- **实际发给 API 的仍是 `off / low / high / max`**，计费与能力不受影响

| 显示名 | 实际档位 |
| --- | --- |
| 小难梁 | `off` |
| 梁子 | `low` |
| 梁圣 | `high` |
| 梁祖 | `max` |

> 上游还有另一种六段映射（两个模型 × 三档：小难梁 / 牢梁 / 梁子 / 梁圣 / 梁神 / 梁祖），见 [BruzWJ/Liang-Saint-Slider](https://github.com/BruzWJ/Liang-Saint-Slider)。这里用四档版本，因为桌面端默认只挂 `deepseek-flash` 一个模型。

## 为什么不直接装上游

上游 [dsh-thinking-slider](https://github.com/MuFeng262/dsh-thinking-slider) 能用，但档位名直接照搬适配器给的 `Off / Low / High / Max`——它是刻意数据驱动的，没有改名配置。

社区里另一个更花哨的版本 [BruzWJ/Liang-Saint-Slider](https://github.com/BruzWJ/Liang-Saint-Slider) 有中文名，但**在桌面发行版上静默失效**：它的浏览器端第一行就 `require("@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives")`。这个包确实发布在 npm 上（`0.2.1-rc.2`），但没被打进桌面版的 `app.asar`。DSH 的客户端模块表是冻结的，表里没有的模块会让整个模块工厂函数抛异常，插件在浏览器里静默不注册——宿主那半照常工作（静态资源路由还能返回 200），于是表现成「装上了、没界面」。

所以这个仓库的做法是：**以上游 0.3.3 的构建产物为基础，只替换渲染层的档位名**。上游只依赖 `react` / `react-dom` / `react/jsx-runtime`，这三个内置 UI 自己也在用，所以在发行版上能跑。

## 包结构

```
package.json         dsh.bundle + dsh.client 声明
cordis.patch.yml     插入插件行
lib/index.js         Host 半（空实现）
lib/client.js        浏览器半：上游 0.3.3 产物 + 档位名映射
scripts/sync-upstream.mjs
```

`lib/client.js` 是上游构建产物（MIT）的副本，只改了一处。详见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。

## 跟进上游

上游发新版时，不需要手工改代码：

```powershell
node scripts/sync-upstream.mjs 0.3.4
```

脚本会从 unpkg 拉取新产物、校验锚点行存在、注入映射、写出 `lib/client.js`，并打印 sha256。上游若改动了那段代码结构，脚本会直接报错而不是产出坏包——那时候改一下锚点即可（`scripts/sync-upstream.mjs` 顶部）。

改完把 `package.json` 的版本改成 `<上游版本>-liang.N`，提交推送。**从 GitHub 安装的插件不会自动更新**，重新执行一次 `dsh plugin ... add` 或先 `remove` 再 `add` 即可。

## 已验证

- DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`，Windows 11，2026-10-18
- 上游 `dsh-thinking-slider@0.3.3`
- 客户端产物 `node --check` 通过；档位切换真实写入 `reasoningEffort`

## 已知限制

- 模型列表里每行的小圆点标题（悬停 tooltip）仍走另一条代码路径，还是英文；主界面可见的档位名都已替换
- 这是构建产物副本，上游改版后需要跑一次同步脚本
- 与上游插件**不能同时装**：两者都占 `conversation.input.model` 座位，只是优先级不同，会导致行为难以预期

## 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-thinking-slider-liang
```

## 许可

MIT。上游插件与其中大部分代码归 [MuFeng262](https://github.com/MuFeng262/dsh-thinking-slider) 所有，本仓库仅做显示名替换与发行版兼容性验证。

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: 专门为 agent 打造的开源 agent 搜索工具，具备 200+的搜索源及多语言搜索能力，覆盖中文/英文/学术/代码/购物/金融/新闻/百科。
plugins.readme_text:
中文 · English · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español

介绍 · 对比 · 证明 · 机制 · 快速开始 · 能力 · 配置 · 更新

> **这是踏雪寻仙 DeepSeek Harness 插件系列的一员**（[dsh-files](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-files) 39★ · [dsh-models](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-models) 模型选择 + 子代理路由 + 推理层级）。同作者完整技能系列：[session-digger](https://github.com/taxueseek/session-digger) 29★ · [taxue-invest](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-invest) 21★ · [taxueskills](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxueskills) 23★ · [taxue-creative-style](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-creative-style) 12★ ## 它和「模型自带搜索 / AI 搜索 / 聚合搜索」比，强在哪 > 简单来说：前三种方案解决「**人**找信息」，Argo 解决「**Agent 及搜索核查于一身，具备一条龙的搜索服务**」。差别不在界面，在交付物，给人看的叫总结页或链接清单，给 Agent 的应是能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的优质内容，更可靠的搜索信息。

| 维度 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 垂直问题（行情 / 化学式） | 泛搜网页 | 泛搜再总结 | 泛搜网页 | **直连垂直源，直接给答案** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 重复查询 | 每次都打网 | 每次都打网 | 靠页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | ## 性能 Benchmark | 指标 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 热查询延迟 | ~2000ms | ~1500ms | ~800ms | **~10ms** | | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 缓存 | 无 | 页面缓存 | 页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite）** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | ## 架构 ### 主流程 ```mermaid graph LR A[用户查询] --> B[语言检测] B --> C[引擎分诊] C --> D[并行搜索] D --> E[结果聚合] E --> F[可信度评分] F --> G[JSON 输出] H[双层缓存] -.-> D I[预算控制] -.-> C ``` ### 引擎分诊流程 ```mermaid graph TD A[用户查询] --> B{语言检测} B -->|中文| C[中文引擎组] B -->|英文| D[英文引擎组] B -->|日韩| E[日韩引擎组] B -->|其他| F[通用引擎组] C --> G{领域判断} D --> G E --> G F --> G G -->|学术| H[学术引擎] G -->|代码| I[代码引擎] G -->|购物| J[购物引擎] G -->|金融| K[金融引擎] G -->|新闻| L[新闻引擎] G -->|通用| M[网页引擎] H --> N[并行搜索] I --> N J --> N K --> N L --> N M --> N ``` ### 缓存机制 ```mermaid graph LR A[查询请求] --> B{内存缓存} B -->|命中| C[直接返回] B -->|未命中| D{SQLite 缓存} D -->|命中| E[返回并更新内存] D -->|未命中| F[执行搜索] F --> G[结果写入 SQLite] G --> H[结果写入内存] H --> I[返回结果] ``` ### 可信度评分流程 ```mermaid graph TD A[搜索结果] --> B[Selection 评分] A --> C[Absorption 评分] A --> D[Freshness 评分] A --> E[共识评分] B --> F[综合可信度] C --> F D --> F E --> F F --> G{阈值判断} G -->|高于阈值| H[保留] G -->|低于阈值| I[丢弃] H --> J[JSON 输出] ``` ### 预算控制流程 ```mermaid graph LR A[搜索请求] --> B{预算检查} B -->|预算充足| C[免费引擎优先] B -->|预算紧张| D[仅免费引擎] B -->|预算耗尽| E[返回缓存] C --> F{免费引擎有结果?} D --> F F -->|有| G[返回结果] F -->|无| H{有 Key?} H -->|有| I[付费引擎搜索] H -->|无| J[返回空结果] I --> G ``` ### 整体架构 ```mermaid graph TB subgraph 用户层 A[Agent / 用户] end subgraph 接入层 B[CLI] C[MCP Server] D[Python SDK] end subgraph 核心层 E[语言检测] F[引擎分诊] G[并行搜索] H[结果聚合] I[可信度评分] end subgraph 数据层 J[内存缓存] K[SQLite 缓存] L[265+ 搜索引擎] end subgraph 控制层 M[预算控制] N[多语言支持] end A --> B A --> C A --> D B --> E C --> E D --> E E --> F F --> G G --> H H --> I J -.-> G K -.-> G L --> G M -.-> F N -.-> E I --> A ``` > 机制上，Argo 把搜索当成一条**证据管线**：语言检测 → 领域路由 → 多引擎召回 → RRF 融合 → 证据快评，交付的是 Agent 可直接排序、可 `fetch` 复核、不撑爆上下文的材料。工具链不用换，需要换的是「搜索结果应该长什么样」——再往下一层，还有和「再包一层搜索 API 的差别」，那是实现细节的对比。 --- ## 2026，检索正在发生什么变化 Agent 干活的量级变了，检索的玩法跟着变了四件事，每一件 Argo 都已经落在代码里： 1. **检索从「给链接」变成「给证据」。** Agent 不看网页排版，它要能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的结构化材料——所以 Argo 交付的是带可信度分解的 JSON，而不是 SERP 清单。 2. **上下文成为第一成本。** 一次网页抓取动辄上万 token，Agent 的窗口烧不起。Argo 的 Agent 档单次约 3.7KB，字段集合与字节预算都有检查卡着，升级不会悄悄变胖。 3. **网站开始为 AI 备料。** llms.txt 标准与 `.md` 直出在头部文档站快速铺开——Argo 抓取链第零级自动探测这些 AI 友好变体，命中即跳过整条反爬链；HTTP/TLS 都失败还有 r.jina.ai 阅读器级保底。 4. **免费开放生态够用了。** 政府、学术、标准、安全机构的开放 API + 免 key 引擎，已经能覆盖大多数领域（221 个免配置源）；稀缺免费额度（firecrawl 1000 credits/月、stackexchange 300 次/天）做了「日常补位、关键顶上」的分层，订阅墙不是唯一解。 5. **检索质量从「感觉」到「度量」。** 排序有金标（MRR/nDCG 地板）、融合有增益消融检查、路由有负向控制矩阵——「这版比上版好吗」从此是数字问题，不是玄学。 > v2.9.3 把以上全部落地：264 个源、94 个领域、229 个免配置开箱。逐项细节见 [docs/为什么选择argo.md](docs/为什么选择argo.md) 与 [发布说明](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v2.9.0.md)。 --- ## 这是什么 **Argo 是给 AI Agent 用的多语言搜索基础设施。** 真实检索从来不是「一种语言 + 一个搜索框」：有人问 A 股行情，有人问 World Cup，有人用日文找动画，有人要 IMDb 上的导演信息。Argo 的出发点很朴素——**按领域、按语言、按需求选路**，把问题送到合适的源，而不是一律扫网页标题。联网搜索与本机文件搜索一体可用。 > 产出不是「链接清单」，而是「证据候选 + 可信度分解」。路选对了，证据才站得住。 ### 和「再包一层搜索 API」的差别 | 常见做法 | Argo | |---------|------| | 绑死一个引擎、一个 Key | 多引擎自动选路，免费优先、可配预算 | | 啥问题都泛搜网页 | **垂直源优先**：行情、影视、体育、宏观、化学等先给答案型结果 | | 默认只按中英优化 | **多语言识别 + 引擎语言参数 + 跨语言回退** | | 搜完直接拼摘要 | 选择门槛 × 证据密度 × 时效 × 多源共识 | | 引擎挂了整条链路挂 | 熔断、负缓存、分阶恢复（防垂直源串味） | | 每次查询都重新打网 | 双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms 级 | | 日常和研究一个慢 | **日常少开引擎、研究再放宽** | | Agent 上下文被长 JSON 撑爆 | MCP 响应可紧凑裁剪，snippet 可控 | --- ## 问啥像啥

| 你这样问 | 大致会怎样 | |----------|------------| | python asyncio error handling | 编程问答域 → StackOverflow/StackExchange 官方 API，带得分与采纳标记 | | AAPL / 美股盘前 | 美股域，与 A 股分流 | | 肖申克的救赎 主演 / Inception director | 影视域 → IMDb 等 | | 梅西 俱乐部 / 库里 球队 | 体育域 → TheSportsDB 等 | | 埃菲尔铁塔在哪 / where is Eiffel Tower | 地理实体 → OpenStreetMap 等 | | NASA founding year / 国务院职能 | 组织实体 → Wikidata 等 | | 周杰伦 专辑 / Taylor Swift album | 媒体域 → iTunes 等 | | アニメ おすすめ / 한국 영화 추천 | 识别日/韩语 → 语言友好源，少塞中文专用站 | | 美国 CPI、日本 通胀率 | 宏观数据域；国别分流（本国权威源优先） | | log4j 漏洞 CVSS / nodejs 22 end of life | 安全域 → NVD 官方；生命周期域 → endoflife.date | | attention is all you need | 学术域 → arXiv/OpenAlex/CrossRef，元数据与 DOI 直连 | | 阿司匹林 分子式 | 化学域 → PubChem 类答案 | | 台积电估值分歧（深度研究） | 拆子问题 + 多源并行，垂直源被 boost | --- ## 它怎么工作

``` 查询 ├─ 意图消歧（可选） ├─ 查询改写（可选；路由仍看原始意图） ├─ 语言检测 + 语言偏好 ├─ 路由（域规则 + TF-IDF + 预算 + 语言补充源 + 热路径缓存） ├─ 多引擎召回（熔断 / 负缓存 / 并行） ├─ 空结果分阶恢复（放宽 → 换同族/通用 → 跨语言；防污染） ├─ RRF 融合 + 可选精排 ├─ 证据快评（权威 · 证据密度 · 时效 · 共识） └─ 统一 JSON（含 engine_outcomes / recovery / route_reason） ``` ### 证据评分（简版） ``` selection ≈ 域名权威，SERP/跳转链压到很低 absorption ≈ 数字 / 定义 / 对比 / 披露等证据密度 freshness ≈ 发布时间（会忽略「2015 年以来」这类历史对比年） 综合 ≈ 0.40·selection + 0.35·absorption + 0.15·freshness + 0.10·引擎分 ``` 结果字段含 `selection`、`absorption`、`credibility_fast`、`evidence_flags` 等，方便 Agent 直接排序。 ### Agent 使用纪律（建议） 1. **高后果问题**（持仓、安全、是否属实）：search → 看快评分 → 对 top 结果 `fetch` → 再下结论 2. **数字**：写清计算方式，冲突时并列，不要硬合并 3. **搜索结果页 / 跳转链**：不要当正文信源 4. **社交帖**：当舆情与叙事，不当事实真值 5. **事实核查**：宁可多一两条分层查

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory.
